1.zh: 便雅悯地亚拿突城的祭司中，希勒家的儿子耶利米的话记在下面。
1.en: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, one of the priests who were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin.

1.zh: 犹大王亚们的儿子约西亚在位十三年，耶和华的话临到耶利米。
1.en: The LORD’s word came to him in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.

1.zh: 从犹大王约西亚的儿子约雅敬在位的时候，直到犹大王约西亚的儿子西底家在位的末年，就是十一年五月间耶路撒冷人被掳的时候，耶和华的话也常临到耶利米。
1.en: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, to the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah, the son of Josiah, king of Judah, to the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month.

1.zh: 耶利米说，耶和华的话临到我说：
1.en: Now the LORD’s word came to me, saying,

1.zh: 我未将你造在腹中，我已晓得你； 你未出母胎，我已分别你为圣； 我已派你作列国的先知。
1.en: “Before I formed you in the womb, I knew you. Before you were born, I sanctified you. I have appointed you a prophet to the nations.”

1.zh: 我就说：主耶和华啊，我不知怎样说，因为我是年幼的。
1.en: Then I said, “Ah, Lord GOD! Behold, I don’t know how to speak; for I am a child.”

1.zh: 耶和华对我说： 你不要说我是年幼的， 因为我差遣你到谁那里去，你都要去； 我吩咐你说什么话，你都要说。
1.en: But the LORD said to me, “Don’t say, ‘I am a child;’ for you must go to whomever I send you, and you must say whatever I command you.

1.zh: 你不要惧怕他们， 因为我与你同在， 要拯救你。 这是耶和华说的。
1.en: Don’t be afraid because of them, for I am with you to rescue you,” says the LORD.

1.zh: 于是耶和华伸手按我的口，对我说： 我已将当说的话传给你。
1.en: Then the LORD stretched out his hand and touched my mouth. Then the LORD said to me, “Behold, I have put my words in your mouth.

1.zh: 看哪，我今日立你在列邦列国之上， 为要施行拔出、拆毁、毁坏、倾覆， 又要建立、栽植。
1.en: Behold, I have today set you over the nations and over the kingdoms, to uproot and to tear down, to destroy and to overthrow, to build and to plant.”

1.zh: 耶和华的话又临到我说：「耶利米，你看见什么？」我说：「我看见一根杏树枝。」
1.en: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying, “Jeremiah, what do you see?” I said, “I see a branch of an almond tree.”

1.zh: 耶和华对我说：「你看得不错；因为我留意保守我的话，使得成就。」
1.en: Then the LORD said to me, “You have seen well; for I watch over my word to perform it.”

1.zh: 耶和华的话第二次临到我说：「你看见什么？」我说：「我看见一个烧开的锅，从北而倾。」
1.en: The LORD’s word came to me the second time, saying, “What do you see?” I said, “I see a boiling cauldron; and it is tipping away from the north.”

1.zh: 耶和华对我说：「必有灾祸从北方发出，临到这地的一切居民。」
1.en: Then the LORD said to me, “Out of the north, evil will break out on all the inhabitants of the land.

1.zh: 耶和华说：「看哪，我要召北方列国的众族；他们要来，各安座位在耶路撒冷的城门口，周围攻击城墙，又要攻击犹大的一切城邑。
1.en: For behold, I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north,” says the LORD. “They will come, and they will each set his throne at the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all its walls all around, and against all the cities of Judah.

1.zh: 至于这民的一切恶，就是离弃我、向别神烧香、跪拜自己手所造的，我要发出我的判语，攻击他们。
1.en: I will utter my judgments against them concerning all their wickedness, in that they have forsaken me, and have burned incense to other gods, and worshiped the works of their own hands.

1.zh: 所以你当束腰，起来将我所吩咐你的一切话告诉他们；不要因他们惊惶，免得我使你在他们面前惊惶。
1.en: “You therefore put your belt on your waist, arise, and say to them all that I command you. Don’t be dismayed at them, lest I dismay you before them.

1.zh: 看哪，我今日使你成为坚城、铁柱、铜墙，与全地和犹大的君王、首领、祭司，并地上的众民反对。
1.en: For behold, I have made you today a fortified city, an iron pillar, and bronze walls against the whole land—against the kings of Judah, against its princes, against its priests, and against the people of the land.

1.zh: 他们要攻击你，却不能胜你；因为我与你同在，要拯救你。这是耶和华说的。」
1.en: They will fight against you, but they will not prevail against you; for I am with you”, says the LORD, “to rescue you.”

2.zh: 耶和华的话临到我说：
2.en: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,

2.zh: 「你去向耶路撒冷人的耳中喊叫说，耶和华如此说： 你幼年的恩爱， 婚姻的爱情， 你怎样在旷野， 在未曾耕种之地跟随我， 我都记得。
2.en: “Go and proclaim in the ears of Jerusalem, saying, ‘The LORD says, “I remember for you the kindness of your youth, your love as a bride, how you went after me in the wilderness, in a land that was not sown.

2.zh: 那时以色列归耶和华为圣， 作为土产初熟的果子； 凡吞吃它的必算为有罪， 灾祸必临到他们。 这是耶和华说的。
2.en: Israel was holiness to the LORD, the first fruits of his increase. All who devour him will be held guilty. Evil will come on them,”’ says the LORD.”

2.zh: 雅各家、以色列家的各族啊，你们当听耶和华的话。
2.en: Hear the LORD’s word, O house of Jacob, and all the families of the house of Israel!

2.zh: 耶和华如此说： 你们的列祖见我有什么不义， 竟远离我，随从虚无的神， 自己成为虚妄的呢？
2.en: The LORD says, “What unrighteousness have your fathers found in me, that they have gone far from me, and have walked after worthless vanity, and have become worthless?

2.zh: 他们也不说： 那领我们从埃及地上来， 引导我们经过旷野， 沙漠有深坑之地， 和干旱死荫、无人经过、 无人居住之地的耶和华在哪里呢？
2.en: They didn’t say, ‘Where is the LORD who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, who led us through the wilderness, through a land of deserts and of pits, through a land of drought and of the shadow of death, through a land that no one passed through, and where no man lived?’

2.zh: 我领你们进入肥美之地， 使你们得吃其中的果子和美物； 但你们进入的时候就玷污我的地， 使我的产业成为可憎的。
2.en: I brought you into a plentiful land to eat its fruit and its goodness; but when you entered, you defiled my land, and made my heritage an abomination.

2.zh: 祭司都不说，耶和华在哪里呢？ 传讲律法的都不认识我。 官长违背我； 先知借巴力说预言， 随从无益的[神]。
2.en: The priests didn’t say, ‘Where is the LORD?’ and those who handle the law didn’t know me. The rulers also transgressed against me, and the prophets prophesied by Baal and followed things that do not profit.

2.zh: 耶和华说：我因此必与你们争辩， 也必与你们的子孙争辩。
2.en: “Therefore I will yet contend with you,” says the LORD, “and I will contend with your children’s children.

2.zh: 你们且过到基提海岛去察看， 打发人往基达去留心查考， 看曾有这样的事没有。
2.en: For pass over to the islands of Kittim, and see. Send to Kedar, and consider diligently, and see if there has been such a thing.

2.zh: 岂有一国换了[他的]神吗？ 其实这不是神！ 但我的百姓将他们的荣耀换了那无益的[神]。
2.en: Has a nation changed its gods, which really are no gods? But my people have changed their glory for that which doesn’t profit.

2.zh: 诸天哪，要因此惊奇， 极其恐慌，甚为凄凉！ 这是耶和华说的。
2.en: “Be astonished, you heavens, at this and be horribly afraid. Be very desolate,” says the LORD.

2.zh: 因为我的百姓做了两件恶事， 就是离弃我这活水的泉源， 为自己凿出池子， 是破裂不能存水的池子。
2.en: “For my people have committed two evils: they have forsaken me, the spring of living waters, and cut out cisterns for themselves: broken cisterns that can’t hold water.

2.zh: 以色列是仆人吗？ 是家中生的[奴仆]吗？ 为何成为掠物呢？
2.en: Is Israel a slave? Is he born into slavery? Why has he become a captive?

2.zh: 少壮狮子向他咆哮，大声吼叫， 使他的地荒凉； 城邑也都焚烧，无人居住。
2.en: The young lions have roared at him and raised their voices. They have made his land waste. His cities are burned up, without inhabitant.

2.zh: 挪弗人和答比匿人也打破你的头顶。
2.en: The children also of Memphis and Tahpanhes have broken the crown of your head.

2.zh: 这事临到你身上，不是你自招的吗？ 不是因耶和华—你　神引你行路的时候， 你离弃他吗？
2.en: “Haven’t you brought this on yourself, in that you have forsaken the LORD your God, when he led you by the way?

2.zh: 现今你为何在埃及路上要喝西曷的水呢？ 你为何在亚述路上要喝大河的水呢？
2.en: Now what do you gain by going to Egypt, to drink the waters of the Shihor? Or why do you go on the way to Assyria, to drink the waters of the River?

2.zh: 你自己的恶必惩治你； 你背道的事必责备你。 由此可知可见，你离弃耶和华—你的　神， 不存敬畏我的心， 乃为恶事，为苦事。 这是主—万军之耶和华说的。
2.en: “Your own wickedness will correct you, and your backsliding will rebuke you. Know therefore and see that it is an evil and bitter thing, that you have forsaken the LORD your God, and that my fear is not in you,” says the Lord, GOD of Armies.

2.zh: 我在古时折断你的轭，解开你的绳索。 你说：我必不事奉[耶和华]； 因为你在各高冈上、各青翠树下屈身行淫。
2.en: “For long ago I broke off your yoke, and burst your bonds. You said, ‘I will not serve;’ for on every high hill and under every green tree you bowed yourself, playing the prostitute.

2.zh: 然而，我栽你是上等的葡萄树， 全然是真种子； 你怎么向我变为外邦葡萄树的坏枝子呢？
2.en: Yet I had planted you a noble vine, a pure and faithful seed. How then have you turned into the degenerate branches of a foreign vine to me?

2.zh: 你虽用硷、多用肥皂洗濯， 你罪孽的痕迹仍然在我面前显出。 这是主耶和华说的。
2.en: For though you wash yourself with lye, and use much soap, yet your iniquity is marked before me,” says the Lord GOD.

2.zh: 你怎能说： 我没有玷污、没有随从众巴力？ 你看你谷中的路，就知道你所行的如何。 你是快行的独峰驼，狂奔乱走。
2.en: “How can you say, ‘I am not defiled. I have not gone after the Baals’? See your way in the valley. Know what you have done. You are a swift dromedary traversing her ways,

2.zh: 你是野驴，惯在旷野， 欲心发动就吸风； 起性的时候谁能使它转去呢？ 凡寻找它的必不致疲乏； 在它的月分必能寻见。
2.en: a wild donkey used to the wilderness, that sniffs the wind in her craving. When she is in heat, who can turn her away? All those who seek her will not weary themselves. In her month, they will find her.

2.zh: 我[说]：你不要使脚上无鞋， 喉咙干渴。 你倒说：这是枉然。 我喜爱别[神]，我必随从他们。
2.en: “Keep your feet from being bare, and your throat from thirst. But you said, ‘It is in vain. No, for I have loved strangers, and I will go after them.’

2.zh: 贼被捉拿，怎样羞愧， 以色列家和他们的君王、首领、 祭司、先知也都照样羞愧。
2.en: As the thief is ashamed when he is found, so the house of Israel is ashamed— they, their kings, their princes, their priests, and their prophets,

2.zh: 他们向木头说：你是我的父； 向石头说：你是生我的。 他们以背向我， 不以面向我； 及至遭遇患难的时候却说： 起来拯救我们。
2.en: who tell wood, ‘You are my father,’ and a stone, ‘You have given birth to me,’ for they have turned their back to me, and not their face, but in the time of their trouble they will say, ‘Arise, and save us!’

2.zh: 你为自己做的神在哪里呢？ 你遭遇患难的时候， 叫他们起来拯救你吧！ 犹大啊，你神的数目与你城的数目相等。
2.en: “But where are your gods that you have made for yourselves? Let them arise, if they can save you in the time of your trouble, for you have as many gods as you have towns, O Judah.

2.zh: 耶和华说： 你们为何与我争辩呢？ 你们都违背了我。
2.en: “Why will you contend with me? You all have transgressed against me,” says the LORD.

2.zh: 我责打你们的儿女是徒然的， 他们不受惩治。 你们自己的刀吞灭你们的先知， 好像残害的狮子。
2.en: “I have struck your children in vain. They received no correction. Your own sword has devoured your prophets, like a destroying lion.

2.zh: 这世代的人哪， 你们要看明耶和华的话。 我岂向以色列作旷野呢？ 或作幽暗之地呢？ 我的百姓为何说： 我们脱离约束，再不归向你了？
2.en: Generation, consider the LORD’s word. Have I been a wilderness to Israel? Or a land of thick darkness? Why do my people say, ‘We have broken loose. We will come to you no more’?

2.zh: 处女岂能忘记她的妆饰呢？ 新妇岂能忘记她的美衣呢？ 我的百姓却忘记了我无数的日子！
2.en: “Can a virgin forget her ornaments, or a bride her attire? Yet my people have forgotten me for days without number.

2.zh: 你怎么修饰你的道路要求爱情呢？ 就是恶劣的妇人你也叫她们行你的路。
2.en: How well you prepare your way to seek love! Therefore you have even taught the wicked women your ways.

2.zh: 并且你的衣襟上有无辜穷人的血； [你杀他们]并不是遇见他们挖窟窿， 乃是因这一切的事。
2.en: Also the blood of the souls of the innocent poor is found in your skirts. You didn’t find them breaking in, but it is because of all these things.

2.zh: 你还说：我无辜； 耶和华的怒气必定向我消了。 看哪，我必审问你； 因你自说：我没有犯罪。
2.en: “Yet you said, ‘I am innocent. Surely his anger has turned away from me.’ “Behold, I will judge you, because you say, ‘I have not sinned.’

2.zh: 你为何东跑西奔要更换你的路呢？ 你必因埃及蒙羞， 像从前因亚述蒙羞一样。
2.en: Why do you go about so much to change your ways? You will be ashamed of Egypt also, as you were ashamed of Assyria.

2.zh: 你也必两手抱头从埃及出来； 因为耶和华已经弃绝你所倚靠的， 你必不因他们得顺利。
2.en: You will also leave that place with your hands on your head; for the LORD has rejected those in whom you trust, and you won’t prosper with them.

3.zh: 有话说：人若休妻， 妻离他而去，作了别人的妻， 前夫岂能再收回她来？ [若收回她来]，那地岂不是大大玷污了吗？ 但你和许多亲爱的行邪淫， 还可以归向我。 这是耶和华说的。
3.en: “They say, ‘If a man puts away his wife, and she goes from him, and becomes another man’s, should he return to her again?’ Wouldn’t that land be greatly polluted? But you have played the prostitute with many lovers; yet return again to me,” says the LORD.

3.zh: 你向净光的高处举目观看， 你在何处没有淫行呢？ 你坐在道旁等候， 好像阿拉伯人在旷野[埋伏]一样， 并且你的淫行邪恶玷污了全地。
3.en: “Lift up your eyes to the bare heights, and see! Where have you not been lain with? You have sat waiting for them by the road, as an Arabian in the wilderness. You have polluted the land with your prostitution and with your wickedness.

3.zh: 因此甘霖停止， 春雨不降。 你还是有娼妓之脸， 不顾羞耻。
3.en: Therefore the showers have been withheld and there has been no latter rain; yet you have had a prostitute’s forehead and you refused to be ashamed.

3.zh: 从今以后，你岂不向我呼叫[说]： 我父啊，你是我幼年的恩主。
3.en: Will you not from this time cry to me, ‘My Father, you are the guide of my youth!’?

3.zh: 耶和华岂永远怀[怒]，存留到底吗？ 看哪，你又发恶言又行坏事， 随自己的私意而行。」
3.en: “‘Will he retain his anger forever? Will he keep it to the end?’ Behold, you have spoken and have done evil things, and have had your way.”

3.zh: 约西亚王在位的时候，耶和华又对我说：「背道的以色列所行的，你看见没有？她上各高山，在各青翠树下行淫。
3.en: Moreover, the LORD said to me in the days of Josiah the king, “Have you seen that which backsliding Israel has done? She has gone up on every high mountain and under every green tree, and has played the prostitute there.

3.zh: 她行这些事以后，我说她必归向我，她却不归向我。她奸诈的妹妹犹大也看见了。
3.en: I said after she had done all these things, ‘She will return to me;’ but she didn’t return, and her treacherous sister Judah saw it.

3.zh: 背道的以色列行淫，我为这缘故给她休书休她；我看见她奸诈的妹妹犹大，还不惧怕，也去行淫。
3.en: I saw when, for this very cause, that backsliding Israel had committed adultery, I had put her away and given her a certificate of divorce, yet treacherous Judah, her sister, had no fear, but she also went and played the prostitute.

3.zh: 因以色列轻忽了她的淫乱，和石头木头行淫，地就被玷污了。
3.en: Because she took her prostitution lightly, the land was polluted, and she committed adultery with stones and with wood.

3.zh: 虽有这一切的事，她奸诈的妹妹犹大还不一心归向我，不过是假意归我。这是耶和华说的。」
3.en: Yet for all this her treacherous sister, Judah, has not returned to me with her whole heart, but only in pretense,” says the LORD.

3.zh: 耶和华对我说：「背道的以色列比奸诈的犹大还显为义。
3.en: The LORD said to me, “Backsliding Israel has shown herself more righteous than treacherous Judah.

3.zh: 你去向北方宣告说： 耶和华说：背道的以色列啊，回来吧！ 我必不怒目看你们； 因为我是慈爱的， 我必不永远存[怒]。 这是耶和华说的。
3.en: Go, and proclaim these words toward the north, and say, ‘Return, you backsliding Israel,’ says the LORD; ‘I will not look in anger on you, for I am merciful,’ says the LORD. ‘I will not keep anger forever.

3.zh: 只要承认你的罪孽， 就是你违背耶和华—你的　神， 在各青翠树下向别[神]东奔西跑， 没有听从我的话。 这是耶和华说的。
3.en: Only acknowledge your iniquity, that you have transgressed against the LORD your God, and have scattered your ways to the strangers under every green tree, and you have not obeyed my voice,’” says the LORD.

3.zh: 耶和华说：背道的儿女啊，回来吧！ 因为我作你们的丈夫， 并且我必将你们从一城取一人， 从一族取两人，带到锡安。
3.en: “Return, backsliding children,” says the LORD, “for I am a husband to you. I will take one of you from a city, and two from a family, and I will bring you to Zion.

3.zh: 我也必将合我心的牧者赐给你们。他们必以知识和智慧牧养你们。」
3.en: I will give you shepherds according to my heart, who will feed you with knowledge and understanding.

3.zh: 耶和华说：「你们在国中生养众多；当那些日子，人必不再提说耶和华的约柜，不追想，不记念，不觉缺少，也不再制造。
3.en: It will come to pass, when you are multiplied and increased in the land in those days,” says the LORD, “they will no longer say, ‘the ark of the LORD’s covenant!’ It will not come to mind. They won’t remember it. They won’t miss it, nor will another be made.

3.zh: 那时，人必称耶路撒冷为耶和华的宝座；万国必到耶路撒冷，在耶和华[立]名[的地方]聚集。他们必不再随从自己顽梗的恶心行事。
3.en: At that time they will call Jerusalem ‘The LORD’s Throne;’ and all the nations will be gathered to it, to the LORD’s name, to Jerusalem. They will no longer walk after the stubbornness of their evil heart.

3.zh: 当那些日子，犹大家要和以色列家同行，从北方之地一同来到我赐给你们列祖为业之地。」
3.en: In those days the house of Judah will walk with the house of Israel, and they will come together out of the land of the north to the land that I gave for an inheritance to your fathers.

3.zh: 我说：我怎样将你安置在儿女之中， 赐给你美地， 就是万国中肥美的产业。 我又说：你们必称我为父， 也不再转去不跟从我。
3.en: “But I said, ‘How I desire to put you among the children, and give you a pleasant land, a goodly heritage of the armies of the nations!’ and I said, ‘You shall call me “My Father”, and shall not turn away from following me.’

3.zh: 以色列家，你们向我行诡诈， 真像妻子行诡诈离开她丈夫一样。 这是耶和华说的。
3.en: “Surely as a wife treacherously departs from her husband, so you have dealt treacherously with me, house of Israel,” says the LORD.

3.zh: 在净光的高处听见人声， 就是以色列人哭泣恳求之声， 乃因他们走弯曲之道， 忘记耶和华—他们的　神。
3.en: A voice is heard on the bare heights, the weeping and the petitions of the children of Israel; because they have perverted their way, they have forgotten the LORD their God.

3.zh: 你们这背道的儿女啊，回来吧！ 我要医治你们背道的病。 看哪，我们来到你这里， 因你是耶和华—我们的　神。
3.en: Return, you backsliding children, and I will heal your backsliding. “Behold, we have come to you; for you are the LORD our God.

3.zh: [仰望]从小山或从大山的喧嚷中[得帮助]， 真是枉然的。 以色列得救，诚然在乎耶和华—我们的　神。
3.en: Truly help from the hills, the tumult on the mountains, is in vain. Truly the salvation of Israel is in the LORD our God.

3.zh: 从我们幼年以来，那可耻的[偶像]将我们列祖所劳碌得来的羊群、牛群，和他们的儿女都吞吃了。
3.en: But the shameful thing has devoured the labor of our fathers from our youth, their flocks and their herds, their sons and their daughters.

3.zh: 我们在羞耻中躺卧吧！愿惭愧将我们遮盖；因为从立国以来，我们和我们的列祖常常得罪耶和华—我们的　神，没有听从耶和华—我们　神的话。
3.en: Let us lie down in our shame, and let our confusion cover us; for we have sinned against the LORD our God, we and our fathers, from our youth even to this day. We have not obeyed the LORD our God’s voice.”

4.zh: 耶和华说：以色列啊， 你若回来归向我， 若从我眼前除掉你可憎的[偶像]， 你就不被迁移。
4.en: “If you will return, Israel,” says the LORD, “if you will return to me, and if you will put away your abominations out of my sight; then you will not be removed;

4.zh: 你必凭诚实、公平、公义， 指着永生的耶和华起誓； 列国必因耶和华称自己为有福， 也必因他夸耀。
4.en: and you will swear, ‘As the LORD lives,’ in truth, in justice, and in righteousness. The nations will bless themselves in him, and they will glory in him.”

4.zh: 耶和华对犹大和耶路撒冷人如此说： 要开垦你们的荒地， 不要撒种在荆棘中。
4.en: For the LORD says to the men of Judah and to Jerusalem, “Break up your fallow ground, and don’t sow among thorns.

4.zh: 犹大人和耶路撒冷的居民哪， 你们当自行割礼，归耶和华， 将心里的污秽除掉； 恐怕我的忿怒因你们的恶行发作， 如火着起， 甚至无人能以熄灭！
4.en: Circumcise yourselves to the LORD, and take away the foreskins of your heart, you men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem; lest my wrath go out like fire, and burn so that no one can quench it, because of the evil of your doings.

4.zh: 你们当传扬在犹大， 宣告在耶路撒冷说： 你们当在国中吹角，高声呼叫说： 你们当聚集！ 我们好进入坚固城！
4.en: Declare in Judah, and publish in Jerusalem; and say, ‘Blow the trumpet in the land!’ Cry aloud and say, ‘Assemble yourselves! Let’s go into the fortified cities!’

4.zh: 应当向锡安竖立大旗。 要逃避，不要迟延， 因我必使灾祸与大毁灭从北方来到。
4.en: Set up a standard toward Zion. Flee for safety! Don’t wait; for I will bring evil from the north, and a great destruction.”

4.zh: 有狮子从密林中上来， 是毁坏列国的。 它已经动身出离本处， 要使你的地荒凉， 使你的城邑变为荒场无人居住。
4.en: A lion has gone up from his thicket, and a destroyer of nations. He is on his way. He has gone out from his place, to make your land desolate, that your cities be laid waste, without inhabitant.

4.zh: 因此，你们当腰束麻布，大声哀号， 因为耶和华的烈怒没有向我们转消。
4.en: For this, clothe yourself with sackcloth, lament and wail; for the fierce anger of the LORD hasn’t turned back from us.

4.zh: 耶和华说：「到那时，君王和首领的心都要消灭；祭司都要惊奇，先知都要诧异。」
4.en: “It will happen at that day,” says the LORD, “that the heart of the king will perish, along with the heart of the princes. The priests will be astonished, and the prophets will wonder.”

4.zh: 我说：「哀哉！主耶和华啊，你真是大大地欺哄这百姓和耶路撒冷，说：『你们必得平安。』其实刀剑害及性命了。」
4.en: Then I said, “Ah, Lord GOD! Surely you have greatly deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, ‘You will have peace;’ whereas the sword reaches to the heart.”

4.zh: 那时，必有话对这百姓和耶路撒冷说：「有一阵热风从旷野净光的高处向我的众民刮来，不是为簸扬，也不是为扬净。
4.en: At that time it will be said to this people and to Jerusalem, “A hot wind blows from the bare heights in the wilderness toward the daughter of my people, not to winnow, nor to cleanse.

4.zh: 必有一阵更大的风从这些地方为我刮来；现在我又必发出判语，攻击他们。」
4.en: A full wind from these will come for me. Now I will also utter judgments against them.”

4.zh: 看哪，仇敌必如云上来； 他的战车如旋风， 他的马匹比鹰更快。 我们有祸了！ 我们败落了！
4.en: Behold, he will come up as clouds, and his chariots will be as the whirlwind. His horses are swifter than eagles. Woe to us! For we are ruined.

4.zh: 耶路撒冷啊，你当洗去心中的恶， 使你可以得救。 恶念存在你心里要到几时呢？
4.en: Jerusalem, wash your heart from wickedness, that you may be saved. How long will your evil thoughts lodge within you?

4.zh: 有声音从但传扬， 从以法莲山报祸患。
4.en: For a voice declares from Dan, and publishes evil from the hills of Ephraim:

4.zh: 你们当传给列国， 报告攻击耶路撒冷的事说： 有探望的人从远方来到， 向犹大的城邑大声呐喊。
4.en: “Tell the nations, behold, publish against Jerusalem, ‘Watchers come from a far country, and raise their voice against the cities of Judah.

4.zh: 他们周围攻击耶路撒冷， 好像看守田园的， 因为她背叛了我。 这是耶和华说的。
4.en: As keepers of a field, they are against her all around, because she has been rebellious against me,’” says the LORD.

4.zh: 你的行动，你的作为，招惹这事； 这是你罪恶的结果， 实在是苦， 是害及你心了！
4.en: “Your way and your doings have brought these things to you. This is your wickedness, for it is bitter, for it reaches to your heart.”

4.zh: 我的肺腑啊，我的肺腑啊，我心疼痛！ 我心在我里面烦躁不安。 我不能静默不言， 因为我已经听见角声和打仗的喊声。
4.en: My anguish, my anguish! I am pained at my very heart! My heart trembles within me. I can’t hold my peace, because you have heard, O my soul, the sound of the trumpet, the alarm of war.

4.zh: 毁坏的信息连络不绝， 因为全地荒废。 我的帐棚忽然毁坏； 我的幔子顷刻破裂。
4.en: Destruction on destruction is decreed, for the whole land is laid waste. Suddenly my tents are destroyed, and my curtains gone in a moment.

4.zh: 我看见大旗，听见角声， 要到几时呢？
4.en: How long will I see the standard and hear the sound of the trumpet?

4.zh: [耶和华说]：我的百姓愚顽，不认识我； 他们是愚昧无知的儿女， 有智慧行恶，没有知识行善。
4.en: “For my people are foolish. They don’t know me. They are foolish children, and they have no understanding. They are skillful in doing evil, but they don’t know how to do good.”

4.zh: [先知说]：我观看地， 不料，地是空虚混沌； 我观看天，天也无光。
4.en: I saw the earth and, behold, it was waste and void, and the heavens, and they had no light.

4.zh: 我观看大山，不料，尽都震动， 小山也都摇来摇去。
4.en: I saw the mountains, and behold, they trembled, and all the hills moved back and forth.

4.zh: 我观看，不料，无人； 空中的飞鸟也都躲避。
4.en: I saw, and behold, there was no man, and all the birds of the sky had fled.

4.zh: 我观看，不料，肥田变为荒地； 一切城邑在耶和华面前， 因他的烈怒都被拆毁。
4.en: I saw, and behold, the fruitful field was a wilderness, and all its cities were broken down at the presence of the LORD, before his fierce anger.

4.zh: 耶和华如此说：全地必然荒凉， 我却不毁灭净尽。
4.en: For the LORD says, “The whole land will be a desolation; yet I will not make a full end.

4.zh: 因此，地要悲哀， 在上的天也必黑暗； 因为我言已出，我意已定， 必不后悔，也不转意不做。
4.en: For this the earth will mourn, and the heavens above be black, because I have spoken it. I have planned it, and I have not repented, neither will I turn back from it.”

4.zh: 各城的人因马兵和弓箭手的响声就都逃跑， 进入密林，爬上磐石； 各城被撇下， 无人住在其中。
4.en: Every city flees for the noise of the horsemen and archers. They go into the thickets and climb up on the rocks. Every city is forsaken, and not a man dwells therein.

4.zh: 你凄凉的时候要怎样行呢？ 你虽穿上朱红[衣服]， 佩戴黄金装饰， 用颜料修饰眼目， 这样标致是枉然的！ 恋爱[你的]藐视你， 并且寻索你的性命。
4.en: You, when you are made desolate, what will you do? Though you clothe yourself with scarlet, though you deck yourself with ornaments of gold, though you enlarge your eyes with makeup, you make yourself beautiful in vain. Your lovers despise you. They seek your life.

4.zh: 我听见有声音，仿佛妇人产难的声音， 好像生头胎疼痛[的声音]， 是锡安女子的声音； 她喘着气、挓挲手， [说]：我有祸了！ 在杀人的跟前，我的心发昏了。
4.en: For I have heard a voice as of a woman in travail, the anguish as of her who gives birth to her first child, the voice of the daughter of Zion, who gasps for breath, who spreads her hands, saying, “Woe is me now! For my soul faints before the murderers.”

5.zh: 你们当在耶路撒冷的街上跑来跑去， 在宽阔处寻找， 看看有一人行公义求诚实没有？ [若有]，我就赦免这城。
5.en: “Run back and forth through the streets of Jerusalem, and see now, and know, and seek in its wide places, if you can find a man, if there is anyone who does justly, who seeks truth, then I will pardon her.

5.zh: 其中的人虽然指着永生的耶和华起誓， 所起的誓实在是假的。
5.en: Though they say, ‘As the LORD lives,’ surely they swear falsely.”

5.zh: 耶和华啊，你的眼目不是看顾诚实吗？ 你击打他们，他们却不伤恸； 你毁灭他们，他们仍不受惩治。 他们使脸刚硬过于磐石， 不肯回头。
5.en: O LORD, don’t your eyes look on truth? You have stricken them, but they were not grieved. You have consumed them, but they have refused to receive correction. They have made their faces harder than a rock. They have refused to return.

5.zh: 我说：这些人实在是贫穷的，是愚昧的， 因为不晓得耶和华的作为 和他们　神的法则。
5.en: Then I said, “Surely these are poor. They are foolish; for they don’t know the LORD’s way, nor the law of their God.

5.zh: 我要去见尊大的人，对他们说话， 因为他们晓得耶和华的作为 和他们　神的法则。 哪知，这些人齐心将轭折断， 挣开绳索。
5.en: I will go to the great men and will speak to them, for they know the way of the LORD, and the law of their God.” But these with one accord have broken the yoke, and burst the bonds.

5.zh: 因此，林中的狮子必害死他们； 晚上的豺狼必灭绝他们； 豹子要在城外窥伺他们。 凡出城的必被撕碎； 因为他们的罪过极多， 背道的事也加增了。
5.en: Therefore a lion out of the forest will kill them. A wolf of the evenings will destroy them. A leopard will watch against their cities. Everyone who goes out there will be torn in pieces, because their transgressions are many and their backsliding has increased.

5.zh: 我怎能赦免你呢？ 你的儿女离弃我， 又指着那不是神的起誓。 我使他们饱足， 他们就行奸淫， 成群地聚集在娼妓家里。
5.en: “How can I pardon you? Your children have forsaken me, and sworn by what are no gods. When I had fed them to the full, they committed adultery, and assembled themselves in troops at the prostitutes’ houses.

5.zh: 他们像喂饱的马到处乱跑， 各向他邻舍的妻发嘶声。
5.en: They were as fed horses roaming at large. Everyone neighed after his neighbor’s wife.

5.zh: 耶和华说：我岂不因这些事讨罪呢？ 岂不报复这样的国民呢？
5.en: Shouldn’t I punish them for these things?” says the LORD. “Shouldn’t my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

5.zh: 你们要上她[葡萄园]的墙施行毁坏， 但不可毁坏净尽， 只可除掉她的枝子， 因为不属耶和华。
5.en: “Go up on her walls, and destroy, but don’t make a full end. Take away her branches, for they are not the LORD’s.

5.zh: 原来以色列家和犹大家大行诡诈攻击我。 这是耶和华说的。
5.en: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have dealt very treacherously against me,” says the LORD.

5.zh: 他们不认耶和华，说： 这并不是他， 灾祸必不临到我们； 刀剑和饥荒，我们也看不见。
5.en: They have denied the LORD, and said, “It is not he. Evil won’t come on us. We won’t see sword or famine.

5.zh: 先知[的话]必成为风； 道也不在他们里面。 这[灾]必临到他们身上。
5.en: The prophets will become wind, and the word is not in them. Thus it will be done to them.”

5.zh: 所以耶和华—万军之　神如此说： 因为百姓说这话， 我必使我的话在你口中为火，使他们为柴； 这火便将他们烧灭。
5.en: Therefore the LORD, the God of Armies says, “Because you speak this word, behold, I will make my words in your mouth fire, and this people wood, and it will devour them.

5.zh: 耶和华说：以色列家啊， 我必使一国的民从远方来攻击你， 是强盛的国， 是从古而有的国。 他们的言语你不晓得， 他们的话你不明白。
5.en: Behold, I will bring a nation on you from far away, house of Israel,” says the LORD. “It is a mighty nation. It is an ancient nation, a nation whose language you don’t know and don’t understand what they say.

5.zh: 他们的箭袋是敞开的坟墓； 他们都是勇士。
5.en: Their quiver is an open tomb. They are all mighty men.

5.zh: 他们必吃尽你的庄稼和你的粮食， 是你儿女该吃的； 必吃尽你的牛羊， 吃尽你的葡萄和无花果； 又必用刀毁坏你所倚靠的坚固城。
5.en: They will eat up your harvest and your bread, which your sons and your daughters should eat. They will eat up your flocks and your herds. They will eat up your vines and your fig trees. They will beat down your fortified cities in which you trust with the sword.

5.zh: 耶和华说：「就是到那时，我也不将你们毁灭净尽。
5.en: “But even in those days,” says the LORD, “I will not make a full end of you.

5.zh: 百姓若说：『耶和华—我们的　神为什么向我们行这一切事呢？』你就对他们说：『你们怎样离弃耶和华，在你们的地上事奉外邦神，也必照样在不属你们的地上事奉外邦人。』」
5.en: It will happen when you say, ‘Why has the LORD our God done all these things to us?’ Then you shall say to them, ‘Just as you have forsaken me and served foreign gods in your land, so you will serve strangers in a land that is not yours.’

5.zh: 当传扬在雅各家， 报告在犹大说：
5.en: “Declare this in the house of Jacob, and publish it in Judah, saying,

5.zh: 愚昧无知的百姓啊， 你们有眼不看， 有耳不听， 现在当听这话。
5.en: ‘Hear this now, foolish people without understanding, who have eyes, and don’t see, who have ears, and don’t hear:

5.zh: 耶和华说：你们怎么不惧怕我呢？ 我以永远的定例， 用沙为海的界限， [水]不得越过。 因此，你们在我面前还不战兢吗？ 波浪虽然翻腾，却不能逾越； 虽然匉訇，却不能过去。
5.en: Don’t you fear me?’ says the LORD; ‘Won’t you tremble at my presence, who have placed the sand for the bound of the sea by a perpetual decree, that it can’t pass it? Though its waves toss themselves, yet they can’t prevail. Though they roar, they still can’t pass over it.’

5.zh: 但这百姓有背叛忤逆的心； 他们叛[我]而去，
5.en: “But this people has a revolting and a rebellious heart. They have revolted and gone.

5.zh: 心内也不说： 我们应当敬畏耶和华—我们的　神； 他按时赐雨，就是秋雨春雨， 又为我们定收割的节令，永存不废。
5.en: They don’t say in their heart, ‘Let’s now fear the LORD our God, who gives rain, both the former and the latter, in its season, who preserves to us the appointed weeks of the harvest.’

5.zh: 你们的罪孽使这些事转离你们； 你们的罪恶使你们不能得福。
5.en: “Your iniquities have turned away these things, and your sins have withheld good from you.

5.zh: 因为在我民中有恶人。 他们埋伏窥探，好像捕鸟的人； 他们设立圈套陷害人。
5.en: For wicked men are found among my people. They watch, as fowlers lie in wait. They set a trap. They catch men.

5.zh: 笼内怎样满了雀鸟， 他们的房中也照样充满诡诈； 所以他们得成为大，而且富足。
5.en: As a cage is full of birds, so are their houses full of deceit. Therefore they have become great, and grew rich.

5.zh: 他们肥胖光润， 作恶过甚，不为人伸冤！ 就是不为孤儿伸冤， 不使他亨通， 也不为穷人辨屈。
5.en: They have grown fat. They shine; yes, they excel in deeds of wickedness. They don’t plead the cause, the cause of the fatherless, that they may prosper; and they don’t defend the rights of the needy.

5.zh: 耶和华说：我岂不因这些事讨罪呢？ 岂不报复这样的国民呢？
5.en: “Shouldn’t I punish for these things?” says the LORD. “Shouldn’t my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

5.zh: 国中有可惊骇、可憎恶的事：
5.en: “An astonishing and horrible thing has happened in the land.

5.zh: 就是先知说假预言， 祭司借他们把持权柄； 我的百姓也喜爱这些事， 到了结局你们怎样行呢？
5.en: The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests rule by their own authority; and my people love to have it so. What will you do in the end of it?

6.zh: 便雅悯人哪，你们要逃出耶路撒冷， 在提哥亚吹角， 在伯·哈基琳立号旗； 因为有灾祸与大毁灭从北方张望。
6.en: “Flee for safety, you children of Benjamin, out of the middle of Jerusalem! Blow the trumpet in Tekoa and raise up a signal on Beth Haccherem, for evil looks out from the north with a great destruction.

6.zh: 那秀美娇嫩的锡安女子， 我必剪除。
6.en: I will cut off the beautiful and delicate one, the daughter of Zion.

6.zh: 牧人必引他们的羊群到她那里， 在她周围支搭帐棚， 各在自己[所占]之地[使羊]吃草。
6.en: Shepherds with their flocks will come to her. They will pitch their tents against her all around. They will feed everyone in his place.”

6.zh: 你们要准备攻击她。 起来吧，我们可以趁午时上去。 哀哉！日已渐斜， 晚影拖长了。
6.en: “Prepare war against her! Arise! Let’s go up at noon. Woe to us! For the day declines, for the shadows of the evening are stretched out.

6.zh: 起来吧，我们夜间上去， 毁坏她的宫殿。
6.en: Arise! Let’s go up by night, and let’s destroy her palaces.”

6.zh: 因为万军之耶和华如此说： 你们要砍伐树木， 筑垒攻打耶路撒冷。 这就是那该罚的城， 其中尽是欺压。
6.en: For the LORD of Armies said, “Cut down trees, and cast up a mound against Jerusalem. This is the city to be visited. She is filled with oppression within herself.

6.zh: 井怎样涌出水来， 这城也照样涌出恶来； 在其间常听见有强暴毁灭的事， 病患损伤也常在我面前。
6.en: As a well produces its waters, so she produces her wickedness. Violence and destruction is heard in her. Sickness and wounds are continually before me.

6.zh: 耶路撒冷啊，你当受教， 免得我心与你生疏， 免得我使你荒凉， 成为无人居住之地。
6.en: Be instructed, Jerusalem, lest my soul be alienated from you, lest I make you a desolation, an uninhabited land.”

6.zh: 万军之耶和华曾如此说： 敌人必掳尽以色列剩下的民， 如同摘净葡萄一样。 你要像摘葡萄的人摘了又摘，回手放在筐子里。
6.en: The LORD of Armies says, “They will thoroughly glean the remnant of Israel like a vine. Turn again your hand as a grape gatherer into the baskets.”

6.zh: 现在我可以向谁说话作见证，使他们听呢？ 他们的耳朵未受割礼，不能听见。 看哪，耶和华的话他们以为羞辱， 不以为喜悦。
6.en: To whom should I speak and testify, that they may hear? Behold, their ear is uncircumcised, and they can’t listen. Behold, the LORD’s word has become a reproach to them. They have no delight in it.

6.zh: 因此我被耶和华的忿怒充满，难以含忍。 我要倾在街中的孩童和聚会的少年人身上， 连夫带妻， 并年老的与日子满足的都必被擒拿。
6.en: Therefore I am full of the LORD’s wrath. I am weary with holding it in. “Pour it out on the children in the street, and on the assembly of young men together; for even the husband with the wife will be taken, the aged with him who is full of days.

6.zh: 他们的房屋、田地， 和妻子都必转归别人； 我要伸手攻击这地的居民。 这是耶和华说的。
6.en: Their houses will be turned to others, their fields and their wives together; for I will stretch out my hand on the inhabitants of the land, says the LORD.”

6.zh: 因为他们从最小的到至大的都一味地贪婪， 从先知到祭司都行事虚谎。
6.en: “For from their least even to their greatest, everyone is given to covetousness. From the prophet even to the priest, everyone deals falsely.

6.zh: 他们轻轻忽忽地医治我百姓的损伤， 说：平安了！平安了！ 其实没有平安。
6.en: They have healed also the hurt of my people superficially, saying, ‘Peace, peace!’ when there is no peace.

6.zh: 他们行可憎的事知道惭愧吗？ 不然，他们毫不惭愧， 也不知羞耻。 因此，他们必在仆倒的人中仆倒； 我向他们讨罪的时候， 他们必致跌倒。 这是耶和华说的。
6.en: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? No, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush. Therefore they will fall among those who fall. When I visit them, they will be cast down,” says the LORD.

6.zh: 耶和华如此说： 你们当站在路上察看， 访问古道， 哪是善道，便行在其间； 这样，你们心里必得安息。 他们却说：我们不行[在其间]。
6.en: The LORD says, “Stand in the ways and see, and ask for the old paths, ‘Where is the good way?’ and walk in it, and you will find rest for your souls. But they said, ‘We will not walk in it.’

6.zh: 我设立守望的人照管你们， [说]：要听角声。 他们却说：我们不听。
6.en: I set watchmen over you, saying, ‘Listen to the sound of the trumpet!’ But they said, ‘We will not listen!’

6.zh: 列国啊，因此你们当听！ 会众啊，要知道他们必遭遇的事。
6.en: Therefore hear, you nations, and know, congregation, what is among them.

6.zh: 地啊，当听！ 我必使灾祸临到这百姓， 就是他们意念所结的果子； 因为他们不听从我的言语， 至于我的训诲，他们也厌弃了。
6.en: Hear, earth! Behold, I will bring evil on this people, even the fruit of their thoughts, because they have not listened to my words; and as for my law, they have rejected it.

6.zh: 从示巴出的乳香， 从远方出的菖蒲 奉来给我有何益呢？ 你们的燔祭不蒙悦纳； 你们的[平安]祭，我也不喜悦。
6.en: To what purpose does frankincense from Sheba come to me, and the sweet cane from a far country? Your burnt offerings are not acceptable, and your sacrifices are not pleasing to me.”

6.zh: 所以耶和华如此说： 我要将绊脚石放在这百姓前面。 父亲和儿子要一同跌在其上； 邻舍与朋友也都灭亡。
6.en: Therefore the LORD says, “Behold, I will lay stumbling blocks before this people. The fathers and the sons together will stumble against them. The neighbor and his friend will perish.”

6.zh: 耶和华如此说： 看哪，有一种民从北方而来， 并有一大国被激动，从地极来到。
6.en: The LORD says, “Behold, a people comes from the north country. A great nation will be stirred up from the uttermost parts of the earth.

6.zh: 他们拿弓和枪， 性情残忍，不施怜悯； 他们的声音像海浪匉訇。 锡安城啊， 他们骑马都摆队伍， 如上战场的人要攻击你。
6.en: They take hold of bow and spear. They are cruel, and have no mercy. Their voice roars like the sea, and they ride on horses, everyone set in array, as a man to the battle, against you, daughter of Zion.”

6.zh: 我们听见他们的风声，手就发软； 痛苦将我们抓住， 疼痛仿佛产难的妇人。
6.en: We have heard its report. Our hands become feeble. Anguish has taken hold of us, and pains as of a woman in labor.

6.zh: 你们不要往田野去， 也不要行在路上， 因四围有仇敌的刀剑和惊吓。
6.en: Don’t go out into the field or walk by the way; for the sword of the enemy and terror are on every side.

6.zh: 我民哪，应当腰束麻布，滚在灰中。 你要悲伤，如丧独生子痛痛哭号， 因为灭命的要忽然临到我们。
6.en: Daughter of my people, clothe yourself with sackcloth, and wallow in ashes! Mourn, as for an only son, most bitter lamentation, for the destroyer will suddenly come on us.

6.zh: 我使你在我民中为高台，为保障， 使你知道试验他们的行动。
6.en: “I have made you a tester of metals and a fortress among my people, that you may know and try their way.

6.zh: 他们都是极悖逆的， 往来谗谤人。 他们是铜是铁， 都行坏事。
6.en: They are all grievous rebels, going around to slander. They are bronze and iron. All of them deal corruptly.

6.zh: 风箱吹火，铅被烧毁； 他们炼而又炼，终是徒然； 因为恶劣的还未除掉。
6.en: The bellows blow fiercely. The lead is consumed in the fire. In vain they go on refining, for the wicked are not plucked away.

6.zh: 人必称他们为被弃的银渣， 因为耶和华已经弃掉他们。
6.en: Men will call them rejected silver, because the LORD has rejected them.”

7.zh: 耶和华的话临到耶利米说：
7.en: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

7.zh: 「你当站在耶和华殿的门口，在那里宣传这话说：你们进这些门敬拜耶和华的一切犹大人，当听耶和华的话。
7.en: “Stand in the gate of the LORD’s house, and proclaim this word there, and say, ‘Hear the LORD’s word, all you of Judah, who enter in at these gates to worship the LORD.’”

7.zh: 万军之耶和华—以色列的　神如此说：你们改正行动作为，我就使你们在这地方仍然居住。
7.en: The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel says, “Amend your ways and your doings, and I will cause you to dwell in this place.

7.zh: 你们不要倚靠虚谎的话，说：『这些是耶和华的殿，是耶和华的殿，是耶和华的殿！』
7.en: Don’t trust in lying words, saying, ‘The LORD’s temple, the LORD’s temple, the LORD’s temple, are these.’

7.zh: 「你们若实在改正行动作为，在人和邻舍中间诚然施行公平，
7.en: For if you thoroughly amend your ways and your doings, if you thoroughly execute justice between a man and his neighbor;

7.zh: 不欺压寄居的和孤儿寡妇，在这地方不流无辜人的血，也不随从别神陷害自己，
7.en: if you don’t oppress the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow, and don’t shed innocent blood in this place, and don’t walk after other gods to your own hurt,

7.zh: 我就使你们在这地方仍然居住，就是我古时所赐给你们列祖的地，直到永远。
7.en: then I will cause you to dwell in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers, from of old even forever more.

7.zh: 「看哪，你们倚靠虚谎无益的话。
7.en: Behold, you trust in lying words that can’t profit.

7.zh: 你们偷盗，杀害，奸淫，起假誓，向巴力烧香，并随从素不认识的别神，
7.en: Will you steal, murder, commit adultery, swear falsely, burn incense to Baal, and walk after other gods that you have not known,

7.zh: 且来到这称为我名下的殿，在我面前敬拜；又说：『我们可以自由了。』你们这样的举动是要行那些可憎的事吗？
7.en: then come and stand before me in this house, which is called by my name, and say, ‘We are delivered,’ that you may do all these abominations?

7.zh: 这称为我名下的殿在你们眼中岂可看为贼窝吗？我都看见了。这是耶和华说的。
7.en: Has this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, I myself have seen it,” says the LORD.

7.zh: 你们且往示罗去，就是我先前立为我名的居所，察看我因这百姓以色列的罪恶向那地所行的如何。」
7.en: “But go now to my place which was in Shiloh, where I caused my name to dwell at the first, and see what I did to it for the wickedness of my people Israel.

7.zh: 耶和华说：「现在因你们行了这一切的事，我也从早起来警戒你们，你们却不听从；呼唤你们，你们却不答应。
7.en: Now, because you have done all these works,” says the LORD, “and I spoke to you, rising up early and speaking, but you didn’t hear; and I called you, but you didn’t answer;

7.zh: 所以我要向这称为我名下、你们所倚靠的殿，与我所赐给你们和你们列祖的地施行，照我从前向示罗所行的一样。
7.en: therefore I will do to the house which is called by my name, in which you trust, and to the place which I gave to you and to your fathers, as I did to Shiloh.

7.zh: 我必将你们从我眼前赶出，正如赶出你们的众弟兄，就是以法莲的一切后裔。」
7.en: I will cast you out of my sight, as I have cast out all your brothers, even the whole offspring of Ephraim.

7.zh: 「所以，你不要为这百姓祈祷；不要为他们呼求祷告；也不要向我为他们祈求，因我不听允你。
7.en: “Therefore don’t pray for this people. Don’t lift up a cry or prayer for them or make intercession to me; for I will not hear you.

7.zh: 他们在犹大城邑中和耶路撒冷街上所行的，你没有看见吗？
7.en: Don’t you see what they do in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?

7.zh: 孩子捡柴，父亲烧火，妇女抟面做饼，献给天后，又向别神浇奠祭，惹我发怒。」
7.en: The children gather wood, and the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead the dough, to make cakes to the queen of the sky, and to pour out drink offerings to other gods, that they may provoke me to anger.

7.zh: 耶和华说：「他们岂是惹我发怒呢？不是自己惹祸，以致脸上惭愧吗？」
7.en: Do they provoke me to anger?” says the LORD. “Don’t they provoke themselves, to the confusion of their own faces?”

7.zh: 所以主耶和华如此说：「看哪，我必将我的怒气和忿怒倾在这地方的人和牲畜身上，并田野的树木和地里的出产上，必[如火]着起，不能熄灭。」
7.en: Therefore the Lord GOD says: “Behold, my anger and my wrath will be poured out on this place, on man, on animal, on the trees of the field, and on the fruit of the ground; and it will burn and will not be quenched.”

7.zh: 万军之耶和华—以色列的　神如此说：「你们将燔祭加在[平安]祭上，吃肉吧！
7.en: The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel says: “Add your burnt offerings to your sacrifices and eat meat.

7.zh: 因为我将你们列祖从埃及地领出来的那日，燔祭[平安]祭的事我并没有提说，也没有吩咐他们。
7.en: For I didn’t speak to your fathers or command them in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt concerning burnt offerings or sacrifices;

7.zh: 我只吩咐他们这一件说：『你们当听从我的话，我就作你们的　神，你们也作我的子民。你们行我所吩咐的一切道，就可以得福。』
7.en: but this thing I commanded them, saying, ‘Listen to my voice, and I will be your God, and you shall be my people. Walk in all the way that I command you, that it may be well with you.’

7.zh: 他们却不听从，不侧耳而听，竟随从[自己]的计谋和顽梗的恶心，向后不向前。
7.en: But they didn’t listen or turn their ear, but walked in their own counsels and in the stubbornness of their evil heart, and went backward, and not forward.

7.zh: 自从你们列祖出埃及地的那日，直到今日，我差遣我的仆人众先知到你们那里去，每日从早起来差遣他们。
7.en: Since the day that your fathers came out of the land of Egypt to this day, I have sent to you all my servants the prophets, daily rising up early and sending them.

7.zh: 你们却不听从，不侧耳而听，竟硬着颈项行恶，比你们列祖更甚。
7.en: Yet they didn’t listen to me or incline their ear, but made their neck stiff. They did worse than their fathers.

7.zh: 「你要将这一切的话告诉他们，他们却不听从；呼唤他们，他们却不答应。
7.en: “You shall speak all these words to them, but they will not listen to you. You shall also call to them, but they will not answer you.

7.zh: 你要对他们说：这就是不听从耶和华—他们　神的话、不受教训的国民；从他们的口中，诚实灭绝了。」
7.en: You shall tell them, ‘This is the nation that has not listened to the LORD their God’s voice, nor received instruction. Truth has perished, and is cut off from their mouth.’

7.zh: 耶路撒冷啊，要剪发抛弃， 在净光的高处举哀； 因为耶和华丢掉离弃了惹他忿怒的世代。
7.en: Cut off your hair, and throw it away, and take up a lamentation on the bare heights; for the LORD has rejected and forsaken the generation of his wrath.

7.zh: 耶和华说：「犹大人行我眼中看为恶的事，将可憎之物设立在称为我名下的殿中，污秽这殿。
7.en: “For the children of Judah have done that which is evil in my sight,” says the LORD. “They have set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to defile it.

7.zh: 他们在欣嫩子谷建筑陀斐特的邱坛，好在火中焚烧自己的儿女。这并不是我所吩咐的，也不是我心所起的意。」
7.en: They have built the high places of Topheth, which is in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire, which I didn’t command, nor did it come into my mind.

7.zh: 耶和华说：「因此，日子将到，这地方不再称为陀斐特和欣嫩子谷，反倒称为杀戮谷。因为要在陀斐特葬埋[尸首]，甚至无处[可葬]；
7.en: Therefore behold, the days come”, says the LORD, “that it will no more be called ‘Topheth’ or ‘The valley of the son of Hinnom’, but ‘The valley of Slaughter’; for they will bury in Topheth until there is no place to bury.

7.zh: 并且这百姓的尸首必给空中的飞鸟和地上的野兽作食物，并无人哄赶。
7.en: The dead bodies of this people will be food for the birds of the sky, and for the animals of the earth. No one will frighten them away.

7.zh: 那时，我必使犹大城邑中和耶路撒冷街上，欢喜和快乐的声音，新郎和新妇的声音，都止息了，因为地必成为荒场。」
7.en: Then I will cause to cease from the cities of Judah and from the streets of Jerusalem the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride; for the land will become a waste.”

8.zh: 耶和华说：「到那时，人必将犹大王的骸骨和他首领的骸骨、祭司的骸骨、先知的骸骨，并耶路撒冷居民的骸骨，都从坟墓中取出来，
8.en: “At that time,” says the LORD, “they will bring the bones of the kings of Judah, the bones of his princes, the bones of the priests, the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, out of their graves.

8.zh: 抛散在日头、月亮，和天上众星之下，就是他们从前所喜爱、所事奉、所随从、所求问、所敬拜的。这些骸骨不再收殓，不再葬埋，必在地面上成为粪土；
8.en: They will spread them before the sun, the moon, and all the army of the sky, which they have loved, which they have served, after which they have walked, which they have sought, and which they have worshiped. They will not be gathered or be buried. They will be like dung on the surface of the earth.

8.zh: 并且这恶族所剩下的民在我所赶他们到的各处，宁可拣死不拣生。这是万军之耶和华说的。」
8.en: Death will be chosen rather than life by all the residue that remain of this evil family, that remain in all the places where I have driven them,” says the LORD of Armies.

8.zh: 你要对他们说，耶和华如此说： 人跌倒，不再起来吗？ 人转去，不再转来吗？
8.en: “Moreover you shall tell them, ‘The LORD says: “‘Do men fall, and not rise up again? Does one turn away, and not return?

8.zh: 这耶路撒冷的民，为何恒久背道呢？ 他们守定诡诈，不肯回头。
8.en: Why then have the people of Jerusalem fallen back by a perpetual backsliding? They cling to deceit. They refuse to return.

8.zh: 我留心听，听见他们说不正直的话。 无人悔改恶行，说： 我做的是什么呢？ 他们各人转奔己路， 如马直闯战场。
8.en: I listened and heard, but they didn’t say what is right. No one repents of his wickedness, saying, “What have I done?” Everyone turns to his course, as a horse that rushes headlong in the battle.

8.zh: 空中的鹳鸟知道[来去的]定期； 斑鸠燕子与白鹤也守候当来的时令； 我的百姓却不知道耶和华的法则。
8.en: Yes, the stork in the sky knows her appointed times. The turtledove, the swallow, and the crane observe the time of their coming; but my people don’t know the LORD’s law.

8.zh: 你们怎么说：我们有智慧， 耶和华的律法在我们这里？ 看哪，文士的假笔舞弄虚假。
8.en: “‘How do you say, “We are wise, and the LORD’s law is with us”? But, behold, the false pen of the scribes has made that a lie.

8.zh: 智慧人惭愧，惊惶，被擒拿； 他们弃掉耶和华的话， 心里还有什么智慧呢？
8.en: The wise men are disappointed. They are dismayed and trapped. Behold, they have rejected the LORD’s word. What kind of wisdom is in them?

8.zh: 所以我必将他们的妻子给别人， 将他们的田地给别人为业； 因为他们从最小的到至大的都一味地贪婪， 从先知到祭司都行事虚谎。
8.en: Therefore I will give their wives to others and their fields to those who will possess them. For everyone from the least even to the greatest is given to covetousness; from the prophet even to the priest everyone deals falsely.

8.zh: 他们轻轻忽忽地医治我百姓的损伤，说： 平安了！平安了！ 其实没有平安。
8.en: They have healed the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, “Peace, peace,” when there is no peace.

8.zh: 他们行可憎的事知道惭愧吗？ 不然，他们毫不惭愧， 也不知羞耻。 因此他们必在仆倒的人中仆倒； 我向他们讨罪的时候， 他们必致跌倒。 这是耶和华说的。
8.en: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? No, they were not at all ashamed. They couldn’t blush. Therefore they will fall among those who fall. In the time of their visitation they will be cast down, says the LORD.

8.zh: 耶和华说：我必使他们全然灭绝； 葡萄树上必没有葡萄， 无花果树上必没有果子， 叶子也必枯干。 我所赐给他们的， 必离开他们过去。
8.en: “‘I will utterly consume them, says the LORD. No grapes will be on the vine, no figs on the fig tree, and the leaf will fade. The things that I have given them will pass away from them.’”

8.zh: 我们为何静坐不动呢？ 我们当聚集，进入坚固城， 在那里静默不言； 因为耶和华—我们的　神使我们静默不言， 又将苦胆水给我们喝， 都因我们得罪了耶和华。
8.en: “Why do we sit still? Assemble yourselves! Let’s enter into the fortified cities, and let’s be silent there; for the LORD our God has put us to silence, and given us poisoned water to drink, because we have sinned against the LORD.

8.zh: 我们指望平安， 却得不着好处； 指望痊愈的时候， 不料，受了惊惶。
8.en: We looked for peace, but no good came; and for a time of healing, and behold, dismay!

8.zh: 听见从但那里敌人的马喷鼻气， 他的壮马发嘶声， 全地就都震动； 因为他们来吞灭这地和其上所有的， 吞灭这城与其中的居民。
8.en: The snorting of his horses is heard from Dan. The whole land trembles at the sound of the neighing of his strong ones; for they have come, and have devoured the land and all that is in it, the city and those who dwell therein.”

8.zh: 看哪，我必使毒蛇到你们中间， 是不服法术的， 必咬你们。 这是耶和华说的。
8.en: “For, behold, I will send serpents, adders among you, which will not be charmed; and they will bite you,” says the LORD.

8.zh: 我有忧愁，愿能自慰； 我心在我里面发昏。
8.en: Oh that I could comfort myself against sorrow! My heart is faint within me.

8.zh: 听啊，是我百姓的哀声从极远之地而来， [说]：耶和华不在锡安吗？ 锡安的王不在其中吗？ [耶和华说]：他们为什么以雕刻的偶像 和外邦虚无[的神]惹我发怒呢？
8.en: Behold, the voice of the cry of the daughter of my people from a land that is very far off: “Isn’t the LORD in Zion? Isn’t her King in her?” “Why have they provoked me to anger with their engraved images, and with foreign idols?”

8.zh: 麦秋已过，夏令已完， 我们还未得救！
8.en: “The harvest is past. The summer has ended, and we are not saved.”

8.zh: [先知说]：因我百姓的损伤， 我也受了损伤。 我哀痛，惊惶将我抓住。
8.en: For the hurt of the daughter of my people, I am hurt. I mourn. Dismay has taken hold of me.

8.zh: 在基列岂没有乳香呢？ 在那里岂没有医生呢？ 我百姓为何不得痊愈呢？
8.en: Is there no balm in Gilead? Is there no physician there? Why then isn’t the health of the daughter of my people recovered?

9.zh: 但愿我的头为水， 我的眼为泪的泉源， 我好为我百姓中被杀的人昼夜哭泣。
9.en: Oh that my head were waters, and my eyes a spring of tears, that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people!

9.zh: 惟愿我在旷野有行路人住宿之处， 使我可以离开我的民出去； 因他们都是行奸淫的， 是行诡诈的一党。
9.en: Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men, that I might leave my people and go from them! For they are all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men.

9.zh: 他们弯起舌头像弓一样， 为要说谎话。 他们在国中增长势力， 不是为行诚实， 乃是恶上加恶， 并不认识我。 这是耶和华说的。
9.en: “They bend their tongue, as their bow, for falsehood. They have grown strong in the land, but not for truth; for they proceed from evil to evil, and they don’t know me,” says the LORD.

9.zh: 你们各人当谨防邻舍， 不可信靠弟兄； 因为弟兄尽行欺骗， 邻舍都往来谗谤人。
9.en: “Everyone beware of his neighbor, and don’t trust in any brother; for every brother will utterly supplant, and every neighbor will go around like a slanderer.

9.zh: 他们各人欺哄邻舍，不说真话； 他们教舌头学习说谎， 劳劳碌碌地作孽。
9.en: Friends deceive each other, and will not speak the truth. They have taught their tongue to speak lies. They weary themselves committing iniquity.

9.zh: 你的住处在诡诈的人中； 他们因行诡诈，不肯认识我。 这是耶和华说的。
9.en: Your habitation is in the middle of deceit. Through deceit, they refuse to know me,” says the LORD.

9.zh: 所以万军之耶和华如此说： 看哪，我要将他们熔化熬炼； 不然，我因我百姓[的罪]该怎样行呢？
9.en: Therefore the LORD of Armies says, “Behold, I will melt them and test them; for how should I deal with the daughter of my people?

9.zh: 他们的舌头是毒箭，说话诡诈； 人与邻舍口说和平话， 心却谋害他。
9.en: Their tongue is a deadly arrow. It speaks deceit. One speaks peaceably to his neighbor with his mouth, but in his heart, he waits to ambush him.

9.zh: 耶和华说：我岂不因这些事讨他们的罪呢？ 岂不报复这样的国民呢？
9.en: Shouldn’t I punish them for these things?” says the LORD. “Shouldn’t my soul be avenged on a nation such as this?

9.zh: 我要为山岭哭泣悲哀， 为旷野的草场扬声哀号； 因为都已干焦，甚至无人经过。 人也听不见牲畜鸣叫， 空中的飞鸟和[地上的]野兽都已逃去。
9.en: I will weep and wail for the mountains, and lament for the pastures of the wilderness, because they are burned up, so that no one passes through; Men can’t hear the voice of the livestock. Both the birds of the sky and the animals have fled. They are gone.

9.zh: 我必使耶路撒冷变为乱堆，为野狗的住处， 也必使犹大的城邑变为荒场，无人居住。
9.en: “I will make Jerusalem heaps, a dwelling place of jackals. I will make the cities of Judah a desolation, without inhabitant.”

9.zh: 谁是智慧人，可以明白这事？耶和华的口向谁说过，使他可以传说？遍地为何灭亡，干焦好像旷野，甚至无人经过呢？
9.en: Who is wise enough to understand this? Who is he to whom the mouth of the LORD has spoken, that he may declare it? Why has the land perished and burned up like a wilderness, so that no one passes through?

9.zh: 耶和华说：「因为这百姓离弃我在他们面前所设立的律法，没有遵行，也没有听从我的话；
9.en: The LORD says, “Because they have forsaken my law which I set before them, and have not obeyed my voice or walked in my ways,

9.zh: 只随从自己顽梗的心行事，照他们列祖所教训的随从众巴力。」
9.en: but have walked after the stubbornness of their own heart and after the Baals, which their fathers taught them.”

9.zh: 所以万军之耶和华—以色列的　神如此说：「看哪，我必将茵 给这百姓吃，又将苦胆水给他们喝。
9.en: Therefore the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says, “Behold, I will feed them, even this people, with wormwood and give them poisoned water to drink.

9.zh: 我要把他们散在列邦中，就是他们和他们列祖素不认识的列邦。我也要使刀剑追杀他们，直到将他们灭尽。」
9.en: I will scatter them also among the nations, whom neither they nor their fathers have known. I will send the sword after them, until I have consumed them.”

9.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说： 你们应当思想， 将[善]唱哀歌的妇女召来， 又打发人召善[哭]的妇女来，
9.en: The LORD of Armies says, “Consider, and call for the mourning women, that they may come. Send for the skillful women, that they may come.

9.zh: 叫她们速速为我们举哀， 使我们眼泪汪汪， 使我们的眼皮涌出水来。
9.en: Let them make haste and take up a wailing for us, that our eyes may run down with tears and our eyelids gush out with waters.

9.zh: 因为听见哀声出于锡安，[说]： 我们怎样败落了！ 我们大大地惭愧！ 我们撇下地土； 人也拆毁了我们的房屋。
9.en: For a voice of wailing is heard out of Zion, ‘How we are ruined! We are greatly confounded because we have forsaken the land, because they have cast down our dwellings.’”

9.zh: 妇女们哪，你们当听耶和华的话， 领受他口中的言语； 又当教导你们的儿女举哀， 各人教导邻舍唱哀歌。
9.en: Yet hear the LORD’s word, you women. Let your ear receive the word of his mouth. Teach your daughters wailing. Everyone teach her neighbor a lamentation.

9.zh: 因为死亡上来， 进了我们的窗户， 入了我们的宫殿； 要从外边剪除孩童， 从街上剪除少年人。
9.en: For death has come up into our windows. It has entered into our palaces to cut off the children from outside, and the young men from the streets.

9.zh: 你当说，耶和华如此说： 人的尸首必倒在田野像粪土， 又像收割的人遗落的一把[禾稼]， 无人收取。
9.en: Speak, “The LORD says, “‘The dead bodies of men will fall as dung on the open field, and as the handful after the harvester. No one will gather them.’”

9.zh: 耶和华如此说：「智慧人不要因他的智慧夸口，勇士不要因他的勇力夸口，财主不要因他的财物夸口。
9.en: The LORD says, “Don’t let the wise man glory in his wisdom. Don’t let the mighty man glory in his might. Don’t let the rich man glory in his riches.

9.zh: 夸口的却因他有聪明，认识我是耶和华，又知道我喜悦在世上施行慈爱、公平，和公义，以此夸口。这是耶和华说的。」
9.en: But let him who glories glory in this, that he has understanding, and knows me, that I am the LORD who exercises loving kindness, justice, and righteousness on the earth, for I delight in these things,” says the LORD.

9.zh: 耶和华说：「看哪，日子将到，我要刑罚一切受过割礼、[心]却未受割礼的，
9.en: “Behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that I will punish all those who are circumcised only in their flesh:

9.zh: 就是埃及、犹大、以东、亚扪人、摩押人，和一切住在旷野剃周围[头发]的；因为列国人都没有受割礼，以色列人心中也没有受割礼。」
9.en: Egypt, Judah, Edom, the children of Ammon, Moab, and all who have the corners of their hair cut off, who dwell in the wilderness, for all the nations are uncircumcised, and all the house of Israel are uncircumcised in heart.”

10.zh: 以色列家啊，要听耶和华对你们所说的话。
10.en: Hear the word which the LORD speaks to you, house of Israel!

10.zh: 耶和华如此说： 你们不要效法列国的行为， 也不要为天象惊惶， 因列国为此事惊惶。
10.en: The LORD says, “Don’t learn the way of the nations, and don’t be dismayed at the signs of the sky; for the nations are dismayed at them.

10.zh: 众民的风俗是虚空的； 他们在树林中用斧子砍伐一棵树， 匠人用手工造成[偶像]。
10.en: For the customs of the peoples are vanity; for one cuts a tree out of the forest, the work of the hands of the workman with the ax.

10.zh: 他们用金银妆饰它， 用钉子和锤子钉稳， 使它不动摇。
10.en: They deck it with silver and with gold. They fasten it with nails and with hammers, so that it can’t move.

10.zh: 它好像棕树，是旋成的， 不能说话，不能行走， 必须有人抬着。 你们不要怕它； 它不能降祸， 也无力降福。
10.en: They are like a palm tree, of turned work, and don’t speak. They must be carried, because they can’t move. Don’t be afraid of them; for they can’t do evil, neither is it in them to do good.”

10.zh: 耶和华啊，没有能比你的！ 你本为大，有大能大力的名。
10.en: There is no one like you, LORD. You are great, and your name is great in might.

10.zh: 万国的王啊，谁不敬畏你？ 敬畏你本是合宜的； 因为在列国的智慧人中， 虽有政权的尊荣， 也不能比你。
10.en: Who shouldn’t fear you, King of the nations? For it belongs to you. Because among all the wise men of the nations, and in all their royal estate, there is no one like you.

10.zh: 他们尽都是畜类，是愚昧的。 偶像的训诲算什么呢？ 偶像不过是木头。
10.en: But they are together brutish and foolish, instructed by idols! It is just wood.

10.zh: 有银子打成片，是从他施带来的， 并有从乌法来的金子， 都是匠人和银匠的手工， 又有蓝色紫色料的衣服， 都是巧匠的工作。
10.en: There is silver beaten into plates, which is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz, the work of the engraver and of the hands of the goldsmith. Their clothing is blue and purple. They are all the work of skillful men.

10.zh: 惟耶和华是真　神， 是活　神，是永远的王。 他一发怒，大地震动； 他一恼恨，列国都担当不起。 （
10.en: But the LORD is the true God. He is the living God, and an everlasting King. At his wrath, the earth trembles. The nations aren’t able to withstand his indignation.

10.zh: 你们要对他们如此说：不是那创造天地的神，必从地上从天下被除灭！）
10.en: “You shall say this to them: ‘The gods that have not made the heavens and the earth will perish from the earth, and from under the heavens.’”

10.zh: 耶和华用能力创造大地， 用智慧建立世界， 用聪明铺张穹苍。
10.en: God has made the earth by his power. He has established the world by his wisdom, and by his understanding has he stretched out the heavens.

10.zh: 他一发声，空中便有多水激动； 他使云雾从地极上腾； 他造电随雨而闪， 从他府库中带出风来。
10.en: When he utters his voice, the waters in the heavens roar, and he causes the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth. He makes lightnings for the rain, and brings the wind out of his treasuries.

10.zh: 各人都成了畜类，毫无知识； 各银匠都因他雕刻的偶像羞愧。 他所铸的偶像本是虚假的， 其中并无气息，
10.en: Every man has become brutish and without knowledge. Every goldsmith is disappointed by his engraved image; for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.

10.zh: 都是虚无的， 是迷惑人的工作； 到追讨的时候必被除灭。
10.en: They are vanity, a work of delusion. In the time of their visitation they will perish.

10.zh: 雅各的分不像这些， 因他是造作万有的[主]。 以色列也是他产业的支派， 万军之耶和华是他的名。
10.en: The portion of Jacob is not like these; for he is the maker of all things; and Israel is the tribe of his inheritance. The LORD of Armies is his name.

10.zh: 受围困的人哪，当收拾你的财物， 从国中带出去。
10.en: Gather up your wares out of the land, you who live under siege.

10.zh: 因为耶和华如此说： 这时候，我必将此地的居民， 好像用机弦甩出去， 又必加害在他们身上， 使他们觉悟。
10.en: For the LORD says, “Behold, I will sling out the inhabitants of the land at this time, and will distress them, that they may feel it.”

10.zh: 民[说]：祸哉！我受损伤； 我的伤痕极其重大。 我却说：这真是我的痛苦， 必须忍受。
10.en: Woe is me because of my injury! My wound is serious; but I said, “Truly this is my grief, and I must bear it.”

10.zh: 我的帐棚毁坏； 我的绳索折断。 我的儿女离我出去，没有了。 无人再支搭我的帐棚，挂起我的幔子。
10.en: My tent has been destroyed, and all my cords are broken. My children have gone away from me, and they are no more. There is no one to spread my tent any more, to set up my curtains.

10.zh: 因为牧人都成为畜类， 没有求问耶和华， 所以不得顺利； 他们的羊群也都分散。
10.en: For the shepherds have become brutish, and have not inquired of the LORD. Therefore they have not prospered, and all their flocks have scattered.

10.zh: 有风声！看哪，[敌人]来了！ 有大扰乱从北方出来， 要使犹大城邑变为荒凉， 成为野狗的住处。
10.en: The voice of news, behold, it comes, and a great commotion out of the north country, to make the cities of Judah a desolation, a dwelling place of jackals.

10.zh: 耶和华啊，我晓得人的道路不由自己， 行路的人也不能定自己的脚步。
10.en: LORD, I know that the way of man is not in himself. It is not in man who walks to direct his steps.

10.zh: 耶和华啊，求你从宽惩治我， 不要在你的怒中惩治我， 恐怕使我归于无有。
10.en: LORD, correct me, but gently; not in your anger, lest you reduce me to nothing.

10.zh: 愿你将忿怒倾在不认识你的列国中， 和不求告你名的各族上； 因为他们吞了雅各，不但吞了，而且灭绝， 把他的住处变为荒场。
10.en: Pour out your wrath on the nations that don’t know you, and on the families that don’t call on your name; for they have devoured Jacob. Yes, they have devoured him, consumed him, and have laid waste his habitation.

11.zh: 耶和华的话临到耶利米说：
11.en: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

11.zh: 「当听这约的话，告诉犹大人和耶路撒冷的居民，
11.en: “Hear the words of this covenant, and speak to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem;

11.zh: 对他们说，耶和华—以色列的　神如此说：不听从这约之话的人必受咒诅。
11.en: and say to them, the LORD, the God of Israel says: ‘Cursed is the man who doesn’t hear the words of this covenant,

11.zh: 这约是我将你们列祖从埃及地领出来、脱离铁炉的那日所吩咐他们的，说：『你们要听从我的话，照我一切所吩咐的去行。』这样，你们就作我的子民，我也作你们的　神；
11.en: which I commanded your fathers in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, out of the iron furnace,’ saying, ‘Obey my voice and do them, according to all which I command you; so you shall be my people, and I will be your God;

11.zh: 我好坚定向你们列祖所起的誓，给他们流奶与蜜之地，正如今日一样。」我就回答说：「耶和华啊，阿们！」
11.en: that I may establish the oath which I swore to your fathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey,’ as it is today.” Then I answered, and said, “Amen, LORD.”

11.zh: 耶和华对我说：「你要在犹大城邑中和耶路撒冷街市上，宣告这一切话说：你们当听从遵行这约的话。
11.en: The LORD said to me, “Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying, ‘Hear the words of this covenant, and do them.

11.zh: 因为我将你们列祖从埃及地领出来的那日，直到今日，都是从早起来，切切告诫他们说：『你们当听从我的话。』
11.en: For I earnestly protested to your fathers in the day that I brought them up out of the land of Egypt, even to this day, rising early and protesting, saying, “Obey my voice.”

11.zh: 他们却不听从，不侧耳而听，竟随从自己顽梗的恶心去行。所以我使这约中一切[咒诅]的话临到他们身上；这约是我吩咐他们行的，他们却不去行。」
11.en: Yet they didn’t obey, nor turn their ear, but everyone walked in the stubbornness of their evil heart. Therefore I brought on them all the words of this covenant, which I commanded them to do, but they didn’t do them.’”

11.zh: 耶和华对我说：「在犹大人和耶路撒冷居民中有同谋背叛的事。
11.en: The LORD said to me, “A conspiracy is found among the men of Judah, and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

11.zh: 他们转去效法他们的先祖，不肯听我的话，犯罪作孽，又随从别神，事奉它。以色列家和犹大家背了我与他们列祖所立的约。」
11.en: They have turned back to the iniquities of their forefathers, who refused to hear my words. They have gone after other gods to serve them. The house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken my covenant which I made with their fathers.

11.zh: 所以耶和华如此说：「我必使灾祸临到他们，是他们不能逃脱的。他们必向我哀求，我却不听。
11.en: Therefore the LORD says, ‘Behold, I will bring evil on them which they will not be able to escape; and they will cry to me, but I will not listen to them.

11.zh: 那时，犹大城邑的人和耶路撒冷的居民要去哀求他们烧香所供奉的神；只是遭难的时候，这些神毫不拯救他们。
11.en: Then the cities of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem will go and cry to the gods to which they offer incense, but they will not save them at all in the time of their trouble.

11.zh: 犹大啊，你神的数目与你城的数目相等；你为那可耻的巴力所筑烧香的坛也与耶路撒冷街道的数目相等。
11.en: For according to the number of your cities are your gods, Judah; and according to the number of the streets of Jerusalem you have set up altars to the shameful thing, even altars to burn incense to Baal.’

11.zh: 「所以你不要为这百姓祈祷，不要为他们呼求祷告；因为他们遭难向我哀求的时候，我必不应允。
11.en: “Therefore don’t pray for this people. Don’t lift up cry or prayer for them; for I will not hear them in the time that they cry to me because of their trouble.

11.zh: 我所亲爱的，既行许多淫乱，圣肉也离了你，你在我殿中做什么呢？你作恶就喜乐。
11.en: What has my beloved to do in my house, since she has behaved lewdly with many, and the holy flesh has passed from you? When you do evil, then you rejoice.”

11.zh: 从前耶和华给你起名叫青橄榄树，又华美又结好果子；如今他用哄嚷之声，点火在其上，枝子也被折断。
11.en: The LORD called your name, “A green olive tree, beautiful with goodly fruit.” With the noise of a great roar he has kindled fire on it, and its branches are broken.

11.zh: 原来栽培你的万军之耶和华已经说，要降祸攻击你，是因以色列家和犹大家行恶，向巴力烧香，惹我发怒，是自作自受。」
11.en: For the LORD of Armies, who planted you, has pronounced evil against you, because of the evil of the house of Israel and of the house of Judah, which they have done to themselves in provoking me to anger by offering incense to Baal.

11.zh: 耶和华指示我，我就知道； 你将他们所行的给我指明。
11.en: The LORD gave me knowledge of it, and I knew it. Then you showed me their doings.

11.zh: 我却像柔顺的羊羔被牵到宰杀之地； 我并不知道他们设计谋害我， [说]：我们把树连果子都灭了吧！ 将他从活人之地剪除， 使他的名不再被纪念。
11.en: But I was like a gentle lamb that is led to the slaughter. I didn’t know that they had devised plans against me, saying, “Let’s destroy the tree with its fruit, and let’s cut him off from the land of the living, that his name may be no more remembered.”

11.zh: 按公义判断、察验人肺腑心肠的万军之耶和华啊， 我却要见你在他们身上报仇， 因我将我的案件向你禀明了。
11.en: But, LORD of Armies, who judges righteously, who tests the heart and the mind, I will see your vengeance on them; for to you I have revealed my cause.

11.zh: 所以，耶和华论到寻索你命的亚拿突人如此说：「他们说：你不要奉耶和华的名说预言，免得你死在我们手中。
11.en: “Therefore the LORD says concerning the men of Anathoth, who seek your life, saying, ‘You shall not prophesy in the LORD’s name, that you not die by our hand’—

11.zh: 所以万军之耶和华如此说：看哪，我必刑罚他们；他们的少年人必被刀剑杀死，他们的儿女必因饥荒灭亡，
11.en: therefore the LORD of Armies says, ‘Behold, I will punish them. The young men will die by the sword. Their sons and their daughters will die by famine.

11.zh: 并且没有余剩的人留给他们；因为在追讨之年，我必使灾祸临到亚拿突人。」
11.en: There will be no remnant to them, for I will bring evil on the men of Anathoth, even the year of their visitation.’”

12.zh: 耶和华啊，我与你争辩的时候， 你显为义； 但有一件，我还要与你理论： 恶人的道路为何亨通呢？ 大行诡诈的为何得安逸呢？
12.en: You are righteous, LORD, when I contend with you; yet I would like to plead a case with you. Why does the way of the wicked prosper? Why are they all at ease who deal very treacherously?

12.zh: 你栽培了他们， 他们也扎了根， 长大，而且结果。 他们的口是与你相近， 心却与你远离。
12.en: You have planted them. Yes, they have taken root. They grow. Yes, they produce fruit. You are near in their mouth, and far from their heart.

12.zh: 耶和华啊，你晓得我，看见我， 察验我向你是怎样的心。 求你将他们拉出来， 好像将宰的羊， 叫他们等候杀戮的日子。
12.en: But you, LORD, know me. You see me, and test my heart toward you. Pull them out like sheep for the slaughter, and prepare them for the day of slaughter.

12.zh: 这地悲哀， 通国的青草枯干，要到几时呢？ 因其上居民的恶行， 牲畜和飞鸟都灭绝了。 他们曾说：他看不见我们的结局。
12.en: How long will the land mourn, and the herbs of the whole country wither? Because of the wickedness of those who dwell therein, the animals and birds are consumed; because they said, “He won’t see our latter end.”

12.zh: [耶和华说]：你若与步行的人同跑， 尚且觉累， 怎能与马赛跑呢？ 你在平安之地，虽然安稳， 在约旦河边的丛林要怎样行呢？
12.en: “If you have run with the footmen, and they have wearied you, then how can you contend with horses? Though in a land of peace you are secure, yet how will you do in the pride of the Jordan?

12.zh: 因为连你弟兄和你父家都用奸诈待你。 他们也在你后边大声喊叫， 虽向你说好话， 你也不要信他们。
12.en: For even your brothers, and the house of your father, even they have dealt treacherously with you! Even they have cried aloud after you! Don’t believe them, though they speak beautiful words to you.

12.zh: 我离了我的殿宇， 撇弃我的产业， 将我心里所亲爱的交在她仇敌的手中。
12.en: “I have forsaken my house. I have cast off my heritage. I have given the dearly beloved of my soul into the hand of her enemies.

12.zh: 我的产业向我如林中的狮子， 她发声攻击我， 因此我恨恶她。
12.en: My heritage has become to me as a lion in the forest. She has uttered her voice against me. Therefore I have hated her.

12.zh: 我的产业向我岂如斑点的鸷鸟呢？ 鸷鸟岂在她四围攻击她呢？ 你们要去聚集田野的百兽， 带来吞吃吧！
12.en: Is my heritage to me as a speckled bird of prey? Are the birds of prey against her all around? Go, assemble all the animals of the field. Bring them to devour.

12.zh: 许多牧人毁坏我的葡萄园， 践踏我的分， 使我美好的分变为荒凉的旷野。
12.en: Many shepherds have destroyed my vineyard. They have trodden my portion under foot. They have made my pleasant portion a desolate wilderness.

12.zh: 他们使地荒凉； 地既荒凉，便向我悲哀。 全地荒凉，因无人介意。
12.en: They have made it a desolation. It mourns to me, being desolate. The whole land is made desolate, because no one cares.

12.zh: 灭命的都来到旷野中一切净光的高处； 耶和华的刀从地这边直到地那边尽行杀灭。 凡有血气的都不得平安。
12.en: Destroyers have come on all the bare heights in the wilderness; for the sword of the LORD devours from the one end of the land even to the other end of the land. No flesh has peace.

12.zh: 他们种的是麦子， 收的是荆棘； 劳劳苦苦却毫无益处。 因耶和华的烈怒， 你们必为自己的土产羞愧。
12.en: They have sown wheat, and have reaped thorns. They have exhausted themselves, and profit nothing. You will be ashamed of your fruits, because of the LORD’s fierce anger.”

12.zh: 耶和华如此说：「一切恶邻，就是占据我使百姓以色列所承受产业的，我要将他们拔出本地，又要将犹大家从他们中间拔出来。
12.en: The LORD says, “Concerning all my evil neighbors, who touch the inheritance which I have caused my people Israel to inherit: Behold, I will pluck them up from off their land, and will pluck up the house of Judah from among them.

12.zh: 我拔出他们以后，我必转过来怜悯他们，把他们再带回来，各归本业，各归故土。
12.en: It will happen that after I have plucked them up, I will return and have compassion on them. I will bring them again, every man to his heritage, and every man to his land.

12.zh: 他们若殷勤学习我百姓的道，指着我的名起誓[说]：『我指着永生的耶和华起誓』，正如他们从前教我百姓指着巴力起誓，他们就必建立在我百姓中间。
12.en: It will happen, if they will diligently learn the ways of my people, to swear by my name, ‘As the LORD lives;’ even as they taught my people to swear by Baal, then they will be built up in the middle of my people.

12.zh: 他们若是不听，我必拔出那国，拔出而且毁灭。这是耶和华说的。」
12.en: But if they will not hear, then I will pluck up that nation, plucking up and destroying it,” says the LORD.

13.zh: 耶和华对我如此说：「你去买一根麻布带子束腰，不可放在水中。」
13.en: The LORD said to me, “Go, and buy yourself a linen belt, and put it on your waist, and don’t put it in water.”

13.zh: 我就照着耶和华的话，买了一根带子束腰。
13.en: So I bought a belt according to the LORD’s word, and put it on my waist.

13.zh: 耶和华的话第二次临到我说：
13.en: The LORD’s word came to me the second time, saying,

13.zh: 「要拿着你所买的腰带，就是你腰上的带子，起来往幼发拉底河去，将腰带藏在那里的磐石穴中。」
13.en: “Take the belt that you have bought, which is on your waist, and arise, go to the Euphrates, and hide it there in a cleft of the rock.”

13.zh: 我就去，照着耶和华所吩咐我的，将腰带藏在幼发拉底河边。
13.en: So I went and hid it by the Euphrates, as the LORD commanded me.

13.zh: 过了多日，耶和华对我说：「你起来往幼发拉底河去，将我吩咐你藏在那里的腰带取出来。」
13.en: After many days, the LORD said to me, “Arise, go to the Euphrates, and take the belt from there, which I commanded you to hide there.”

13.zh: 我就往幼发拉底河去，将腰带从我所藏的地方刨出来，见腰带已经变坏，毫无用了。
13.en: Then I went to the Euphrates, and dug, and took the belt from the place where I had hidden it; and behold, the belt was ruined. It was profitable for nothing.

13.zh: 耶和华的话临到我说：
13.en: Then the LORD’s word came to me, saying,

13.zh: 「耶和华如此说：我必照样败坏犹大的骄傲和耶路撒冷的大骄傲。
13.en: “The LORD says, ‘In this way I will ruin the pride of Judah, and the great pride of Jerusalem.

13.zh: 这恶民不肯听我的话，按自己顽梗的心而行，随从别神，事奉敬拜，他们也必像这腰带变为无用。」
13.en: This evil people, who refuse to hear my words, who walk in the stubbornness of their heart, and have gone after other gods to serve them and to worship them, will even be as this belt, which is profitable for nothing.

13.zh: 耶和华说：「腰带怎样紧贴人腰，照样，我也使以色列全家和犹大全家紧贴我，好叫他们属我为子民，使我得名声，得颂赞，得荣耀；他们却不肯听。」
13.en: For as the belt clings to the waist of a man, so I have caused the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah to cling to me,’ says the LORD; ‘that they may be to me for a people, for a name, for praise, and for glory; but they would not hear.’

13.zh: 「所以你要对他们说：『耶和华—以色列的　神如此说：各坛都要盛满了酒。』他们必对你说：『我们岂不确知各坛都要盛满了酒呢？』
13.en: “Therefore you shall speak to them this word: ‘The LORD, the God of Israel says, “Every container should be filled with wine.”’ They will tell you, ‘Do we not certainly know that every container should be filled with wine?’

13.zh: 你就要对他们说：『耶和华如此说：我必使这地的一切居民，就是坐大卫宝座的君王和祭司，与先知，并耶路撒冷的一切居民，都酩酊大醉。』」
13.en: Then tell them, ‘The LORD says, “Behold, I will fill all the inhabitants of this land, even the kings who sit on David’s throne, the priests, the prophets, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, with drunkenness.

13.zh: 耶和华说：「我要使他们彼此相碰，就是父与子彼此相碰；我必不可怜，不顾惜，不怜悯，以致灭绝他们。」
13.en: I will dash them one against another, even the fathers and the sons together,” says the LORD: “I will not pity, spare, or have compassion, that I should not destroy them.”’”

13.zh: 你们当听，当侧耳而听。 不要骄傲，因为耶和华已经说了。
13.en: Hear, and give ear. Don’t be proud, for the LORD has spoken.

13.zh: 耶和华—你们的　神未使黑暗来到， 你们的脚未在昏暗山上绊跌之先， 当将荣耀归给他； 免得你们盼望光明， 他使光明变为死荫， 成为幽暗。
13.en: Give glory to the LORD your God, before he causes darkness, and before your feet stumble on the dark mountains, and while you look for light, he turns it into the shadow of death, and makes it deep darkness.

13.zh: 你们若不听这话， 我必因[你们的]骄傲在暗地哭泣； 我眼必痛哭流泪， 因为耶和华的群众被掳去了。
13.en: But if you will not hear it, my soul will weep in secret for your pride. My eye will weep bitterly, and run down with tears, because the LORD’s flock has been taken captive.

13.zh: 你要对君王和太后说： 你们当自卑，坐在下边； 因你们的头巾， 就是你们的华冠，已经脱落了。
13.en: Say to the king and to the queen mother, “Humble yourselves. Sit down, for your crowns have come down, even the crown of your glory.

13.zh: 南方的城尽都关闭， 无人开放； 犹大全被掳掠， 且掳掠净尽。
13.en: The cities of the South are shut up, and there is no one to open them. Judah is carried away captive: all of them. They are wholly carried away captive.

13.zh: 你们要举目观看从北方来的人。 先前赐给你的群众， 就是你佳美的群众， 如今在哪里呢？
13.en: Lift up your eyes, and see those who come from the north. Where is the flock that was given to you, your beautiful flock?

13.zh: 耶和华立你自己所交的朋友为首，辖制你， 那时你还有什么话说呢？ 痛苦岂不将你抓住像产难的妇人吗？
13.en: What will you say when he sets over you as head those whom you have yourself taught to be friends to you? Won’t sorrows take hold of you, as of a woman in travail?

13.zh: 你若心里说：这一切事为何临到我呢？ 你的衣襟揭起， 你的脚跟受伤， 是因你的罪孽甚多。
13.en: If you say in your heart, “Why have these things come on me?” Your skirts are uncovered because of the greatness of your iniquity, and your heels suffer violence.

13.zh: 古实人岂能改变皮肤呢？ 豹岂能改变斑点呢？ 若能，你们这习惯行恶的便能行善了。
13.en: Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots? Then may you also do good, who are accustomed to do evil.

13.zh: 所以我必用旷野的风吹散他们， 像吹过的碎秸一样。
13.en: “Therefore I will scatter them as the stubble that passes away by the wind of the wilderness.

13.zh: 耶和华说：这是你所当得的， 是我量给你的分； 因为你忘记我， 倚靠虚假。
13.en: This is your lot, the portion measured to you from me,” says the LORD, “because you have forgotten me, and trusted in falsehood.”

13.zh: 所以我要揭起你的衣襟， 蒙在你脸上， 显出你的丑陋。
13.en: Therefore I will also uncover your skirts on your face, and your shame will appear.

13.zh: 你那些可憎恶之事— 就是在田野的山上行奸淫， 发嘶声，做淫乱的事— 我都看见了。 耶路撒冷啊，你有祸了！ 你不肯洁净，还要到几时呢？
13.en: I have seen your abominations, even your adulteries and your neighing, the lewdness of your prostitution, on the hills in the field. Woe to you, Jerusalem! You will not be made clean. How long will it yet be?”

14.zh: 耶和华论到干旱[之灾]的话临到耶利米：
14.en: This is the LORD’s word that came to Jeremiah concerning the drought:

14.zh: 犹大悲哀，城门衰败。 众人披上黑衣坐在地上； 耶路撒冷的哀声上达。
14.en: “Judah mourns, and its gates languish. They sit in black on the ground. The cry of Jerusalem goes up.

14.zh: 他们的贵胄打发家僮打水； 他们来到水池， 见没有水，就拿着空器皿， 蒙羞惭愧，抱头而回。
14.en: Their nobles send their little ones to the waters. They come to the cisterns, and find no water. They return with their vessels empty. They are disappointed and confounded, and cover their heads.

14.zh: 耕地的也蒙羞抱头； 因为无雨降在地上， 地都干裂。
14.en: Because of the ground which is cracked, because no rain has been in the land, the plowmen are disappointed. They cover their heads.

14.zh: 田野的母鹿生下小鹿，就撇弃， 因为无草。
14.en: Yes, the doe in the field also calves and forsakes her young, because there is no grass.

14.zh: 野驴站在净光的高处，喘气好像野狗； 因为无草，眼目失明。
14.en: The wild donkeys stand on the bare heights. They pant for air like jackals. Their eyes fail, because there is no vegetation.

14.zh: 耶和华啊，我们的罪孽虽然作见证告我们， 还求你为你名的缘故行事。 我们本是多次背道，得罪了你。
14.en: Though our iniquities testify against us, work for your name’s sake, LORD; for our rebellions are many. We have sinned against you.

14.zh: 以色列所盼望、在患难时作他救主的啊， 你为何在这地像寄居的， 又像行路的只住一宵呢？
14.en: You hope of Israel, its Savior in the time of trouble, why should you be as a foreigner in the land, and as a wayfaring man who turns aside to stay for a night?

14.zh: 你为何像受惊的人， 像不能救人的勇士呢？ 耶和华啊，你仍在我们中间； 我们也称为你名下的人， 求你不要离开我们。
14.en: Why should you be like a scared man, as a mighty man who can’t save? Yet you, LORD, are in the middle of us, and we are called by your name. Don’t leave us.

14.zh: 耶和华对这百姓如此说： 这百姓喜爱妄行， 不禁止脚步， 所以耶和华不悦纳他们。 现今要记念他们的罪孽， 追讨他们的罪恶。
14.en: The LORD says to this people: “Even so they have loved to wander. They have not restrained their feet. Therefore the LORD does not accept them. Now he will remember their iniquity, and punish them for their sins.”

14.zh: 耶和华又对我说：「不要为这百姓祈祷求好处。
14.en: The LORD said to me, “Don’t pray for this people for their good.

14.zh: 他们禁食的时候，我不听他们的呼求；他们献燔祭和素祭，我也不悦纳；我却要用刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫灭绝他们。」
14.en: When they fast, I will not hear their cry; and when they offer burnt offering and meal offering, I will not accept them; but I will consume them by the sword, by famine, and by pestilence.”

14.zh: 我就说：「唉！主耶和华啊，那些先知常对他们说：『你们必不看见刀剑，也不遭遇饥荒；耶和华要在这地方赐你们长久的平安。』」
14.en: Then I said, “Ah, Lord GOD! Behold, the prophets tell them, ‘You will not see the sword, neither will you have famine; but I will give you assured peace in this place.’”

14.zh: 耶和华对我说：「那些先知托我的名说假预言，我并没有打发他们，没有吩咐他们，也没有对他们说话；他们向你们预言的，乃是虚假的异象和占卜，并虚无的事，以及本心的诡诈。
14.en: Then the LORD said to me, “The prophets prophesy lies in my name. I didn’t send them. I didn’t command them. I didn’t speak to them. They prophesy to you a lying vision, divination, and a thing of nothing, and the deceit of their own heart.

14.zh: 所以耶和华如此说：论到托我名说预言的那些先知，我并没有打发他们；他们还说这地不能有刀剑饥荒，其实那些先知必被刀剑饥荒灭绝。
14.en: Therefore the LORD says concerning the prophets who prophesy in my name, but I didn’t send them, yet they say, ‘Sword and famine will not be in this land.’ Those prophets will be consumed by sword and famine.

14.zh: 听他们说预言的百姓必因饥荒刀剑抛在耶路撒冷的街道上，无人葬埋。他们连妻子带儿女，都是如此。我必将他们的恶倒在他们身上。」
14.en: The people to whom they prophesy will be cast out in the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and the sword. They will have no one to bury them—them, their wives, their sons, or their daughters, for I will pour their wickedness on them.

14.zh: 你要将这话对他们说： 愿我眼泪汪汪， 昼夜不息， 因为我百姓受了裂口破坏的大伤。
14.en: “You shall say this word to them: “‘Let my eyes run down with tears night and day, and let them not cease; for the virgin daughter of my people is broken with a great breach, with a very grievous wound.

14.zh: 我若出往田间， 就见有被刀杀的； 我若进入城内， 就见有因饥荒患病的； 连先知带祭司在国中往来， 也是毫无知识。
14.en: If I go out into the field, then behold, the slain with the sword! If I enter into the city, then behold, those who are sick with famine! For both the prophet and the priest go about in the land, and have no knowledge.’”

14.zh: 你全然弃掉犹大吗？ 你心厌恶锡安吗？ 为何击打我们，以致无法医治呢？ 我们指望平安，却得不着好处； 指望痊愈，不料，受了惊惶。
14.en: Have you utterly rejected Judah? Has your soul loathed Zion? Why have you struck us, and there is no healing for us? We looked for peace, but no good came; and for a time of healing, and behold, dismay!

14.zh: 耶和华啊，我们承认自己的罪恶， 和我们列祖的罪孽， 因我们得罪了你。
14.en: We acknowledge, LORD, our wickedness, and the iniquity of our fathers; for we have sinned against you.

14.zh: 求你为你名的缘故， 不厌恶我们， 不辱没你荣耀的宝座。 求你追念， 不要背了与我们所立的约。
14.en: Do not abhor us, for your name’s sake. Do not disgrace the throne of your glory. Remember, and don’t break your covenant with us.

14.zh: 外邦人虚无[的神]中有能降雨的吗？ 天能自降甘霖吗？ 耶和华—我们的　神啊， 能如此的不是你吗？ 所以，我们仍要等候你， 因为这一切都是你所造的。
14.en: Are there any among the vanities of the nations that can cause rain? Or can the sky give showers? Aren’t you he, the LORD our God? Therefore we will wait for you; for you have made all these things.

15.zh: 耶和华对我说：「虽有摩西和撒母耳站在我面前[代求]，我的心也不顾惜这百姓。你将他们从我眼前赶出，叫他们去吧！
15.en: Then the LORD said to me, “Though Moses and Samuel stood before me, yet my mind would not turn toward this people. Cast them out of my sight, and let them go out!

15.zh: 他们问你说：『我们往哪里去呢？』你便告诉他们，耶和华如此说： 定为死亡的，必致死亡； 定为刀杀的，必交刀杀； 定为饥荒的，必遭饥荒； 定为掳掠的，必被掳掠。」
15.en: It will happen when they ask you, ‘Where shall we go out?’ then you shall tell them, ‘The LORD says: “Such as are for death, to death; such as are for the sword, to the sword; such as are for the famine, to the famine; and such as are for captivity, to captivity.”’

15.zh: 耶和华说：「我命定四样害他们，就是刀剑杀戮、狗类撕裂、空中的飞鸟，和地上的野兽吞吃毁灭；
15.en: “I will appoint over them four kinds,” says the LORD: “the sword to kill, the dogs to tear, the birds of the sky, and the animals of the earth, to devour and to destroy.

15.zh: 又必使他们在天下万国中抛来抛去，都因犹大王希西家的儿子玛拿西在耶路撒冷所行的事。」
15.en: I will cause them to be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth, because of Manasseh, the son of Hezekiah, king of Judah, for that which he did in Jerusalem.

15.zh: 耶路撒冷啊，谁可怜你呢？ 谁为你悲伤呢？ 谁转身问你的安呢？
15.en: For who will have pity on you, Jerusalem? Who will mourn you? Who will come to ask of your welfare?

15.zh: 耶和华说：你弃绝了我， 转身退后； 因此我伸手攻击你，毁坏你。 我后悔甚不耐烦。
15.en: You have rejected me,” says the LORD. “You have gone backward. Therefore I have stretched out my hand against you and destroyed you. I am weary of showing compassion.

15.zh: 我在境内各城门口， 用簸箕簸了我的百姓， 使他们丧掉儿女。 我毁灭他们， 他们仍不转离所行的道。
15.en: I have winnowed them with a fan in the gates of the land. I have bereaved them of children. I have destroyed my people. They didn’t return from their ways.

15.zh: 他们的寡妇在我面前比海沙更多； 我使灭命的午间来， 攻击少年人的母亲， 使痛苦惊吓忽然临到她身上。
15.en: Their widows are increased more than the sand of the seas. I have brought on them against the mother of the young men a destroyer at noonday. I have caused anguish and terrors to fall on her suddenly.

15.zh: 生过七子的妇人力衰气绝； 尚在白昼，日头忽落； 她抱愧蒙羞。 其余的人， 我必在他们敌人跟前，交与刀剑。 这是耶和华说的。
15.en: She who has borne seven languishes. She has given up the spirit. Her sun has gone down while it was yet day. She has been disappointed and confounded. I will deliver their residue to the sword before their enemies,” says the LORD.

15.zh: 我的母亲哪，我有祸了！因你生我作为遍地相争相竞的人。我素来没有借贷与人，人也没有借贷与我，人人[却]都咒骂我。
15.en: Woe is me, my mother, that you have borne me, a man of strife, and a man of contention to the whole earth! I have not lent, neither have men lent to me; yet every one of them curses me.

15.zh: 耶和华说：「我必要坚固你，使你得好处。灾祸苦难临到的时候，我必要使仇敌央求你。（
15.en: The LORD said, “Most certainly I will strengthen you for good. Most certainly I will cause the enemy to make supplication to you in the time of evil and in the time of affliction.

15.zh: 人岂能将铜与铁，就是北方的铁折断呢？）
15.en: Can one break iron, even iron from the north, and bronze?

15.zh: 「我必因你在四境之内所犯的一切罪，把你的货物财宝当掠物，白白地交给[仇敌]。
15.en: I will give your substance and your treasures for a plunder without price, and that for all your sins, even in all your borders.

15.zh: 我也必使仇敌带[这掠物]到你所不认识的地去，因我怒中起的火要将你们焚烧。」
15.en: I will make them to pass with your enemies into a land which you don’t know; for a fire is kindled in my anger, which will burn on you.”

15.zh: 耶和华啊，你是知道的； 求你记念我，眷顾我， 向逼迫我的人为我报仇； 不要向他们忍怒取我[的命]， 要知道我为你的缘故受了凌辱。
15.en: LORD, you know. Remember me, visit me, and avenge me of my persecutors. You are patient, so don’t take me away. Know that for your sake I have suffered reproach.
