44.en: Behold, I watch over them for evil, and not for good; and all the men of Judah who are in the land of Egypt will be consumed by the sword and by the famine, until they are all gone.

44.zh: 脱离刀剑、从埃及地归回犹大地的人数很少；那进入埃及地要在那里寄居的，就是所剩下的犹大人，必知道是谁的话立得住，是我的话呢？是他们的话呢？
44.en: Those who escape the sword will return out of the land of Egypt into the land of Judah few in number. All the remnant of Judah, who have gone into the land of Egypt to live there, will know whose word will stand, mine or theirs.

44.zh: 耶和华说：我在这地方刑罚你们，必有预兆，使你们知道我降祸与你们的话必要立得住。
44.en: “‘This will be the sign to you,’ says the LORD, ‘that I will punish you in this place, that you may know that my words will surely stand against you for evil.’

44.zh: 耶和华如此说：我必将埃及王法老合弗拉交在他仇敌和寻索其命的人手中，像我将犹大王西底家交在他仇敌和寻索其命的巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒手中一样。」
44.en: The LORD says, ‘Behold, I will give Pharaoh Hophra king of Egypt into the hand of his enemies and into the hand of those who seek his life, just as I gave Zedekiah king of Judah into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, who was his enemy and sought his life.’”

45.zh: 犹大王约西亚的儿子约雅敬第四年，尼利亚的儿子巴录将先知耶利米口中所说的话写在书上。耶利米说：
45.en: The message that Jeremiah the prophet spoke to Baruch the son of Neriah, when he wrote these words in a book at the mouth of Jeremiah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, saying,

45.zh: 「巴录啊，耶和华—以色列的　神说：
45.en: “The LORD, the God of Israel, says to you, Baruch:

45.zh: 巴录曾说：『哀哉！耶和华将忧愁加在我的痛苦上，我因唉哼而困乏，不得安歇。』
45.en: ‘You said, “Woe is me now! For the LORD has added sorrow to my pain! I am weary with my groaning, and I find no rest.”’

45.zh: 你要这样告诉他，耶和华如此说：我所建立的，我必拆毁；我所栽植的，我必拔出；在全地我都如此行。
45.en: “You shall tell him, the LORD says: ‘Behold, that which I have built, I will break down, and that which I have planted I will pluck up; and this in the whole land.

45.zh: 你为自己图谋大事吗？不要图谋！我必使灾祸临到凡有血气的。但你无论往哪里去，我必使你以自己的命为掠物。这是耶和华说的。」
45.en: Do you seek great things for yourself? Don’t seek them; for, behold, I will bring evil on all flesh,’ says the LORD, ‘but I will let you escape with your life wherever you go.’”

46.zh: 耶和华论列国的话临到先知耶利米。
46.en: The LORD’s word which came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the nations.

46.zh: 论到关乎埃及王法老尼哥的军队：这军队安营在幼发拉底河边的迦基米施，是巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒在犹大王约西亚的儿子约雅敬第四年所打败的。
46.en: Of Egypt: concerning the army of Pharaoh Necoh king of Egypt, which was by the river Euphrates in Carchemish, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon struck in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah.

46.zh: 你们要预备大小盾牌， 往前上阵。
46.en: “Prepare the buckler and shield, and draw near to battle!

46.zh: 你们套上车， 骑上马！ 顶盔站立， 磨枪贯甲！
46.en: Harness the horses, and get up, you horsemen, and stand up with your helmets. Polish the spears, put on the coats of mail.

46.zh: 我为何看见他们惊惶转身退后呢？ 他们的勇士打败了， 急忙逃跑，并不回头； 惊吓四围都有！ 这是耶和华说的。
46.en: Why have I seen it? They are dismayed and are turned backward. Their mighty ones are beaten down, have fled in haste, and don’t look back. Terror is on every side,” says the LORD.

46.zh: 不要容快跑的逃避； 不要容勇士逃脱； 他们在北方幼发拉底河边绊跌仆倒。
46.en: “Don’t let the swift flee away, nor the mighty man escape. In the north by the river Euphrates they have stumbled and fallen.

46.zh: 像尼罗河涨发， 像江河之水翻腾的是谁呢？
46.en: “Who is this who rises up like the Nile, like rivers whose waters surge?

46.zh: 埃及像尼罗河涨发， 像江河的水翻腾。 他说：我要涨发遮盖遍地； 我要毁灭城邑和其中的居民。
46.en: Egypt rises up like the Nile, like rivers whose waters surge. He says, ‘I will rise up. I will cover the earth. I will destroy cities and its inhabitants.’

46.zh: 马匹上去吧！ 车辆急行吧！ 勇士，就是手拿盾牌的古实人和弗人， 并拉弓的路德族，都出去吧！
46.en: Go up, you horses! Rage, you chariots! Let the mighty men go out: Cush and Put, who handle the shield; and the Ludim, who handle and bend the bow.

46.zh: 那日是主—万军之耶和华报仇的日子， 要向敌人报仇。 刀剑必吞吃得饱， 饮血饮足； 因为主—万军之耶和华 在北方幼发拉底河边有献祭的事。
46.en: For that day is of the Lord, GOD of Armies, a day of vengeance, that he may avenge himself of his adversaries. The sword will devour and be satiated, and will drink its fill of their blood; for the Lord, GOD of Armies, has a sacrifice in the north country by the river Euphrates.

46.zh: 埃及的民哪， 可以上基列取乳香去； 你虽多服良药， 总是徒然，不得治好。
46.en: Go up into Gilead, and take balm, virgin daughter of Egypt. You use many medicines in vain. There is no healing for you.

46.zh: 列国听见你的羞辱， 遍地满了你的哀声； 勇士与勇士彼此相碰， 一齐跌倒。
46.en: The nations have heard of your shame, and the earth is full of your cry; for the mighty man has stumbled against the mighty, they both fall together.”

46.zh: 耶和华对先知耶利米所说的话，论到巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒要来攻击埃及地：
46.en: The word that the LORD spoke to Jeremiah the prophet, how that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon should come and strike the land of Egypt:

46.zh: 你们要传扬在埃及，宣告在密夺， 报告在挪弗、答比匿说： 要站起出队，自作准备， 因为刀剑在你四围施行吞灭的事。
46.en: “Declare in Egypt, publish in Migdol, and publish in Memphis and in Tahpanhes; say, ‘Stand up, and prepare, for the sword has devoured around you.’

46.zh: 你的壮士为何被冲去呢？ 他们站立不住； 因为耶和华驱逐他们，
46.en: Why are your strong ones swept away? They didn’t stand, because the LORD pushed them.

46.zh: 使多人绊跌； 他们也彼此撞倒，说： 起来吧！我们再往本民本地去， 好躲避欺压的刀剑。
46.en: He made many to stumble. Yes, they fell on one another. They said, ‘Arise! Let’s go again to our own people, and to the land of our birth, from the oppressing sword.’

46.zh: 他们在那里喊叫说： 埃及王法老不过是个声音； 他已错过所定的时候了。
46.en: They cried there, ‘Pharaoh king of Egypt is but a noise; he has let the appointed time pass by.’

46.zh: 君王—名为万军之耶和华的说： 我指着我的永生起誓： 尼布甲尼撒来的势派 必像他泊在众山之中， 像迦密在海边一样。
46.en: “As I live,” says the King, whose name is the LORD of Armies, “surely like Tabor among the mountains, and like Carmel by the sea, so he will come.

46.zh: 住在埃及的民哪， 要预备掳去时所用的物件； 因为挪弗必成为荒场， 且被烧毁，无人居住。
46.en: You daughter who dwells in Egypt, furnish yourself to go into captivity; for Memphis will become a desolation, and will be burned up, without inhabitant.

46.zh: 埃及是肥美的母牛犊； 但出于北方的毁灭来到了！来到了！
46.en: “Egypt is a very beautiful heifer; but destruction out of the north has come. It has come.

46.zh: 其中的雇勇好像圈里的肥牛犊， 他们转身退后， 一齐逃跑，站立不住； 因为他们遭难的日子、 追讨的时候已经临到。
46.en: Also her hired men in the middle of her are like calves of the stall, for they also are turned back. They have fled away together. They didn’t stand, for the day of their calamity has come on them, the time of their visitation.

46.zh: 其中的声音好像蛇行一样。 敌人要成队而来，如砍伐树木的手拿斧子攻击他。
46.en: Its sound will go like the serpent, for they will march with an army, and come against her with axes, as wood cutters.

46.zh: 耶和华说： 埃及的树林虽然不能寻察， 敌人却要砍伐， 因他们多于蝗虫，不可胜数。
46.en: They will cut down her forest,” says the LORD, “though it can’t be searched; because they are more than the locusts, and are innumerable.

46.zh: 埃及的民必然蒙羞， 必交在北方人的手中。
46.en: The daughter of Egypt will be disappointed; she will be delivered into the hand of the people of the north.”

46.zh: 万军之耶和华—以色列的　神说：「我必刑罚挪的亚扪和法老，并埃及与埃及的神，以及君王，也必刑罚法老和倚靠他的人。
46.en: The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: “Behold, I will punish Amon of No, and Pharaoh, and Egypt, with her gods and her kings, even Pharaoh, and those who trust in him.

46.zh: 我要将他们交付寻索其命之人的手和巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒与他臣仆的手；以后埃及必再有人居住，与从前一样。这是耶和华说的。」
46.en: I will deliver them into the hand of those who seek their lives, and into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of his servants. Afterwards it will be inhabited, as in the days of old,” says the LORD.

46.zh: 我的仆人雅各啊，不要惧怕！ 以色列啊，不要惊惶！ 因我要从远方拯救你， 从被掳到之地拯救你的后裔。 雅各必回来，得享平靖安逸， 无人使他害怕。
46.en: “But don’t you be afraid, Jacob my servant. Don’t be dismayed, Israel; for, behold, I will save you from afar, and your offspring from the land of their captivity. Jacob will return, and will be quiet and at ease. No one will make him afraid.

46.zh: 我的仆人雅各啊，不要惧怕！ 因我与你同在。 我要将我所赶你到的那些国灭绝净尽， 却不将你灭绝净尽， 倒要从宽惩治你， 万不能不罚你。 这是耶和华说的。
46.en: Don’t be afraid, O Jacob my servant,” says the LORD, “for I am with you; for I will make a full end of all the nations where I have driven you, but I will not make a full end of you, but I will correct you in measure, and will in no way leave you unpunished.”

47.zh: 法老攻击迦萨之先，有耶和华论非利士人的话临到先知耶利米。
47.en: The LORD’s word that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the Philistines, before Pharaoh struck Gaza.

47.zh: 耶和华如此说： 有水从北方发起，成为涨溢的河， 要涨过遍地和其中所有的， 并城和其中所住的。 人必呼喊； 境内的居民都必哀号。
47.en: The LORD says: “Behold, waters rise up out of the north, and will become an overflowing stream, and will overflow the land and all that is therein, the city and those who dwell therein. The men will cry, and all the inhabitants of the land will wail.

47.zh: 听见敌人壮马蹄跳的响声 和战车隆隆、车轮轰轰； 为父的手就发软， 不回头看顾儿女。
47.en: At the noise of the stamping of the hoofs of his strong ones, at the rushing of his chariots, at the rumbling of his wheels, the fathers don’t look back for their children because their hands are so feeble,

47.zh: 因为日子将到， 要毁灭一切非利士人， 剪除帮助泰尔、西顿所剩下的人。 原来耶和华必毁灭非利士人， 就是迦斐托海岛余剩的人。
47.en: because of the day that comes to destroy all the Philistines, to cut off from Tyre and Sidon every helper who remains; for the LORD will destroy the Philistines, the remnant of the isle of Caphtor.

47.zh: 迦萨成了光秃； 平原中所剩的亚实基伦归于无有。 你用刀划身，要到几时呢？
47.en: Baldness has come on Gaza; Ashkelon is brought to nothing. You remnant of their valley, how long will you cut yourself?

47.zh: 耶和华的刀剑哪，你到几时才止息呢？ 你要入鞘，安靖不动。
47.en: “‘You sword of the LORD, how long will it be before you are quiet? Put yourself back into your scabbard; rest, and be still.’

47.zh: 耶和华既吩咐你攻击亚实基伦和海边之地， 他已经派定你，焉能止息呢？
47.en: “How can you be quiet, since the LORD has given you a command? Against Ashkelon, and against the seashore, there he has appointed it.”

48.zh: 论摩押。万军之耶和华—以色列的　神如此说： 尼波有祸了！因变为荒场。 基列亭蒙羞被攻取； 米斯迦蒙羞被毁坏；
48.en: Of Moab. The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: “Woe to Nebo! For it is laid waste. Kiriathaim is disappointed. It is taken. Misgab is put to shame and broken down.

48.zh: 摩押不再被称赞。 有人在希实本设计谋害她，[说]： 来吧！我们将她剪除，不再成国。 玛得缅哪，你也必默默无声； 刀剑必追赶你。
48.en: The praise of Moab is no more. In Heshbon they have devised evil against her: ‘Come! Let’s cut her off from being a nation.’ You also, Madmen, will be brought to silence. The sword will pursue you.

48.zh: 从何罗念有喊荒凉大毁灭的哀声：
48.en: The sound of a cry from Horonaim, desolation and great destruction!

48.zh: 摩押毁灭了！ 她的孩童发哀声，使人听见。
48.en: Moab is destroyed. Her little ones have caused a cry to be heard.

48.zh: 人上鲁希坡随走随哭， 因为在何罗念的下坡听见毁灭的哀声。
48.en: For they will go up by the ascent of Luhith with continual weeping. For at the descent of Horonaim they have heard the distress of the cry of destruction.

48.zh: 你们要奔逃，自救性命， [独自居住]，好像旷野的杜松。
48.en: Flee! Save your lives! Be like the juniper bush in the wilderness.

48.zh: 你因倚靠自己所做的和自己的财宝必被攻取。 基抹和属他的祭司、首领也要一同被掳去。
48.en: For, because you have trusted in your works and in your treasures, you also will be taken. Chemosh will go out into captivity, his priests and his princes together.

48.zh: 行毁灭的必来到各城， 并无一城得免。 山谷必致败落， 平原必被毁坏； 正如耶和华所说的。
48.en: The destroyer will come on every city, and no city will escape; the valley also will perish, and the plain will be destroyed, as the LORD has spoken.

48.zh: 要将翅膀给摩押， 使她可以飞去。 她的城邑必致荒凉， 无人居住。 （
48.en: Give wings to Moab, that she may fly and get herself away: and her cities will become a desolation, without anyone to dwell in them.

48.zh: 懒惰为耶和华行事的，必受咒诅；禁止刀剑不经血的，必受咒诅。）
48.en: “Cursed is he who does the work of the LORD negligently; and cursed is he who keeps back his sword from blood.

48.zh: 摩押自幼年以来常享安逸， [如酒]在渣滓上澄清， 没有从这器皿倒在那器皿里， 也未曾被掳去。 因此，它的原味尚存， 香气未变。
48.en: “Moab has been at ease from his youth, and he has settled on his dregs, and has not been emptied from vessel to vessel, neither has he gone into captivity; therefore his taste remains in him, and his scent is not changed.

48.zh: 耶和华说：「日子将到，我必打发倒[酒]的往她那里去，将她倒出来，倒空她的器皿，打碎她的坛子。
48.en: Therefore behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that I will send to him those who pour off, and they will pour him off; and they will empty his vessels, and break their containers in pieces.

48.zh: 摩押必因基抹羞愧，像以色列家从前倚靠伯特利[的神]羞愧一样。
48.en: Moab will be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Israel was ashamed of Bethel, their confidence.

48.zh: 你们怎么说： 我们是勇士，是有勇力打仗的呢？
48.en: “How do you say, ‘We are mighty men, and valiant men for the war’?

48.zh: 摩押变为荒场， 敌人上去进了她的城邑。 她所特选的少年人下去遭了杀戮； 这是君王—名为万军之耶和华说的。
48.en: Moab is laid waste, and they have gone up into his cities, and his chosen young men have gone down to the slaughter,” says the King, whose name is the LORD of Armies.

48.zh: 摩押的灾殃临近； 她的苦难速速来到。
48.en: “The calamity of Moab is near to come, and his affliction hurries fast.

48.zh: 凡在她四围的和认识她名的， 你们都要为她悲伤，说： 那结实的杖和那美好的棍， 何竟折断了呢？
48.en: All you who are around him, bemoan him; and all you who know his name, say, ‘How the strong staff is broken, the beautiful rod!’

48.zh: 住在底本的民哪， 要从你荣耀的位上下来， 坐受干渴； 因毁灭摩押的上来攻击你， 毁坏了你的保障。
48.en: “You daughter who dwells in Dibon, come down from your glory, and sit in thirst; for the destroyer of Moab has come up against you. He has destroyed your strongholds.

48.zh: 住亚罗珥的啊， 要站在道旁观望， 问逃避的男人和逃脱的女人说： 是什么事呢？
48.en: Inhabitant of Aroer, stand by the way and watch. Ask him who flees, and her who escapes; say, ‘What has been done?’

48.zh: 摩押因毁坏蒙羞； 你们要哀号呼喊， 要在亚嫩旁报告说： 摩押变为荒场！
48.en: Moab is disappointed; for it is broken down. Wail and cry! Tell it by the Arnon, that Moab is laid waste.

48.zh: 「刑罚临到平原之地的何伦、雅杂、米法押、
48.en: Judgment has come on the plain country— on Holon, on Jahzah, on Mephaath,

48.zh: 底本、尼波、伯·低比拉太音、
48.en: on Dibon, on Nebo, on Beth Diblathaim,

48.zh: 基列亭、伯·迦末、伯·米恩、
48.en: on Kiriathaim, on Beth Gamul, on Beth Meon,

48.zh: 加略、波斯拉，和摩押地远近所有的城邑。
48.en: on Kerioth, on Bozrah, and on all the cities of the land of Moab, far or near.

48.zh: 摩押的角砍断了，摩押的膀臂折断了。这是耶和华说的。」
48.en: The horn of Moab is cut off, and his arm is broken,” says the LORD.

48.zh: 「你们要使摩押沉醉，因她向耶和华夸大。她要在自己所吐之中打滚，又要被人嗤笑。
48.en: “Make him drunk, for he magnified himself against the LORD. Moab will wallow in his vomit, and he also will be in derision.

48.zh: 摩押啊，你不曾嗤笑以色列吗？她岂是在贼中查出来的呢？你每逢提到她便摇头。
48.en: For wasn’t Israel a derision to you? Was he found among thieves? For as often as you speak of him, you shake your head.

48.zh: 摩押的居民哪， 要离开城邑，住在山崖里， 像鸽子在深渊口上搭窝。
48.en: You inhabitants of Moab, leave the cities, and dwell in the rock. Be like the dove that makes her nest over the mouth of the abyss.

48.zh: 我们听说摩押人骄傲， 是极其骄傲； 听说他自高自傲， 并且狂妄，居心自大。
48.en: “We have heard of the pride of Moab. He is very proud in his loftiness, his pride, his arrogance, and the arrogance of his heart.

48.zh: 耶和华说： 我知道他的忿怒是虚空的； 他夸大的话一无所成。
48.en: I know his wrath,” says the LORD, “that it is nothing; his boastings have done nothing.

48.zh: 因此，我要为摩押哀号， 为摩押全地呼喊； 人必为吉珥·哈列设人叹息。
48.en: Therefore I will wail for Moab. Yes, I will cry out for all Moab. They will mourn for the men of Kir Heres.

48.zh: 西比玛的葡萄树啊，我为你哀哭， 甚于雅谢人哀哭。 你的枝子蔓延过海， 直长到雅谢海。 那行毁灭的已经临到你夏天的果子 和你所摘的葡萄。
48.en: With more than the weeping of Jazer I will weep for you, vine of Sibmah. Your branches passed over the sea. They reached even to the sea of Jazer. The destroyer has fallen on your summer fruits and on your vintage.

48.zh: 肥田和摩押地的欢喜快乐都被夺去； 我使酒榨的酒绝流， 无人踹酒欢呼； 那欢呼却变为[仇敌的]呐喊。
48.en: Gladness and joy is taken away from the fruitful field and from the land of Moab. I have caused wine to cease from the wine presses. No one will tread with shouting. The shouting will be no shouting.

48.zh: 「希实本人发的哀声达到以利亚利，直达到雅杂；从琐珥达到何罗念，直到伊基拉·施利施亚，因为宁林的水必然干涸。」
48.en: From the cry of Heshbon even to Elealeh, even to Jahaz they have uttered their voice, from Zoar even to Horonaim, to Eglath Shelishiyah; for the waters of Nimrim will also become desolate.

48.zh: 耶和华说：「我必在摩押地使那在邱坛献祭的，和那向他的神烧香的都断绝了。
48.en: Moreover I will cause to cease in Moab,” says the LORD, “him who offers in the high place, and him who burns incense to his gods.

48.zh: 我心腹为摩押哀鸣如箫，我心肠为吉珥·哈列设人也是如此，因摩押人所得的财物都灭没了。
48.en: Therefore my heart sounds for Moab like flutes, and my heart sounds like flutes for the men of Kir Heres. Therefore the abundance that he has gotten has perished.

48.zh: 「各人头上光秃，胡须剪短，手有划伤，腰束麻布。
48.en: For every head is bald, and every beard clipped. There are cuttings on all the hands, and sackcloth on the waist.

48.zh: 在摩押的各房顶上和街市上处处有人哀哭；因我打碎摩押，好像打碎无人喜悦的器皿。这是耶和华说的。
48.en: On all the housetops of Moab, and in its streets, there is lamentation everywhere; for I have broken Moab like a vessel in which no one delights,” says the LORD.

48.zh: 摩押何等毁坏！何等哀号！何等羞愧转背！这样，摩押必令四围的人嗤笑惊骇。」
48.en: “How it is broken down! How they wail! How Moab has turned the back with shame! So will Moab become a derision and a terror to all who are around him.”

48.zh: 耶和华如此说： 仇敌必如大鹰飞起， 展开翅膀，攻击摩押。
48.en: For the LORD says: “Behold, he will fly as an eagle, and will spread out his wings against Moab.

48.zh: 加略被攻取，保障也被占据。 到那日，摩押的勇士心中疼痛如临产的妇人。
48.en: Kerioth is taken, and the strongholds are seized. The heart of the mighty men of Moab at that day will be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.

48.zh: 摩押必被毁灭，不再成国， 因她向耶和华夸大。
48.en: Moab will be destroyed from being a people, because he has magnified himself against the LORD.

48.zh: 耶和华说：摩押的居民哪， 恐惧、陷坑、网罗都临近你。
48.en: Terror, the pit, and the snare are on you, inhabitant of Moab,” says the LORD.

48.zh: 躲避恐惧的必坠入陷坑； 从陷坑上来的必被网罗缠住； 因我必使追讨之年临到摩押。 这是耶和华说的。
48.en: “He who flees from the terror will fall into the pit; and he who gets up out of the pit will be taken in the snare, for I will bring on him, even on Moab, the year of their visitation,” says the LORD.

48.zh: 躲避的人无力站在希实本的影下； 因为有火从希实本发出， 有火焰出于西宏[的城]， 烧尽摩押的角和哄嚷人的头顶。
48.en: “Those who fled stand without strength under the shadow of Heshbon; for a fire has gone out of Heshbon, and a flame from the middle of Sihon, and has devoured the corner of Moab, and the crown of the head of the tumultuous ones.

48.zh: 摩押啊，你有祸了！ 属基抹的民灭亡了！ 因你的众子都被掳去， 你的众女也被掳去。
48.en: Woe to you, O Moab! The people of Chemosh are undone; for your sons are taken away captive, and your daughters into captivity.

48.zh: 耶和华说： 到末后，我还要使被掳的摩押人归回。 摩押受审判的话到此为止。
48.en: “Yet I will reverse the captivity of Moab in the latter days,” says the LORD. Thus far is the judgment of Moab.

49.zh: 论亚扪人。耶和华如此说： 以色列没有儿子吗？ 没有后嗣吗？ 玛勒堪为何得迦得之地为业呢？ 属他的民为何住其中的城邑呢？
49.en: Of the children of Ammon. The LORD says: “Has Israel no sons? Has he no heir? Why then does Malcam possess Gad, and his people dwell in its cities?

49.zh: 耶和华说： 日子将到，我必使人听见打仗的喊声， 是攻击亚扪人拉巴的喊声。 拉巴要成为乱堆； 属她的乡村要被火焚烧。 先前得以色列地为业的， 此时以色列倒要得他们的地为业。 这是耶和华说的。
49.en: Therefore behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that I will cause an alarm of war to be heard against Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and it will become a desolate heap, and her daughters will be burned with fire; then Israel will possess those who possessed him,” says the LORD.

49.zh: 希实本哪，你要哀号， 因为爱地变为荒场。 拉巴的居民哪，要呼喊， 以麻布束腰； 要哭号，在篱笆中跑来跑去； 因玛勒堪和属他的祭司、 首领要一同被掳去。
49.en: “Wail, Heshbon, for Ai is laid waste! Cry, you daughters of Rabbah! Clothe yourself in sackcloth. Lament, and run back and forth among the fences; for Malcam will go into captivity, his priests and his princes together.

49.zh: 背道的民哪， 你们为何因有山谷， 就是水流的山谷夸张呢？ 为何倚靠财宝[说]： 谁能来到我们这里呢？
49.en: Why do you boast in the valleys, your flowing valley, backsliding daughter? You trusted in her treasures, saying, ‘Who will come to me?’

49.zh: 主—万军之耶和华说： 我要使恐吓从四围的人中临到你们； 你们必被赶出， 各人一直前往， 没有人收聚逃民。
49.en: Behold, I will bring a terror on you,” says the Lord, GOD of Armies, “from all who are around you. All of you will be driven completely out, and there will be no one to gather together the fugitives.

49.zh: 后来我还要使被掳的亚扪人归回。 这是耶和华说的。
49.en: “But afterward I will reverse the captivity of the children of Ammon,” says the LORD.

49.zh: 论以东。万军之耶和华如此说： 提幔中再没有智慧吗？ 明哲人不再有谋略吗？ 他们的智慧尽归无有吗？
49.en: Of Edom, the LORD of Armies says: “Is wisdom no more in Teman? Has counsel perished from the prudent? Has their wisdom vanished?

49.zh: 底但的居民哪，要转身逃跑， 住在深密处； 因为我向以扫追讨的时候， 必使灾殃临到他。
49.en: Flee! Turn back! Dwell in the depths, inhabitants of Dedan; for I will bring the calamity of Esau on him when I visit him.

49.zh: 摘葡萄的若来到他那里， 岂不剩下些葡萄呢？ 盗贼若夜间而来， 岂不毁坏直到够了呢？
49.en: If grape gatherers came to you, would they not leave some gleaning grapes? If thieves came by night, wouldn’t they steal until they had enough?

49.zh: 我却使以扫赤露， 显出他的隐密处； 他不能自藏。 他的后裔、弟兄、邻舍尽都灭绝； 他也归于无有。
49.en: But I have made Esau bare, I have uncovered his secret places, and he will not be able to hide himself. His offspring is destroyed, with his brothers and his neighbors; and he is no more.

49.zh: 你撇下孤儿，我必保全他们的命； 你的寡妇可以倚靠我。
49.en: Leave your fatherless children. I will preserve them alive. Let your widows trust in me.”

49.zh: 耶和华如此说：「原不该喝那杯的一定要喝。你能尽免刑罚吗？你必不能免，一定要喝！」
49.en: For the LORD says: “Behold, they to whom it didn’t pertain to drink of the cup will certainly drink; and are you he who will altogether go unpunished? You won’t go unpunished, but you will surely drink.

49.zh: 耶和华说：「我指着自己起誓，波斯拉必令人惊骇、羞辱、咒诅，并且荒凉。她的一切城邑必变为永远的荒场。」
49.en: For I have sworn by myself,” says the LORD, “that Bozrah will become an astonishment, a reproach, a waste, and a curse. All its cities will be perpetual wastes.”

49.zh: 我从耶和华那里听见信息， 并有使者被差往列国去，[说]： 你们聚集来攻击以东， 要起来争战。
49.en: I have heard news from the LORD, and an ambassador is sent among the nations, saying, “Gather yourselves together! Come against her! Rise up to the battle!”

49.zh: 我使你在列国中为最小， 在世人中被藐视。
49.en: “For, behold, I have made you small among the nations, and despised among men.

49.zh: 住在山穴中据守山顶的啊， 论到你的威吓， 你因心中的狂傲自欺； 你虽如大鹰高高搭窝， 我却从那里拉下你来。 这是耶和华说的。
49.en: As for your terror, the pride of your heart has deceived you, O you who dwell in the clefts of the rock, who hold the height of the hill, though you should make your nest as high as the eagle, I will bring you down from there,” says the LORD.

49.zh: 「以东必令人惊骇；凡经过的人就受惊骇，又因她一切的灾祸嗤笑。
49.en: “Edom will become an astonishment. Everyone who passes by it will be astonished, and will hiss at all its plagues.

49.zh: 耶和华说：必无人住在那里，也无人在其中寄居，要像所多玛、蛾摩拉，和邻近的城邑倾覆的时候一样。
49.en: As in the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah and its neighbor cities,” says the LORD, “no man will dwell there, neither will any son of man live therein.

49.zh: 仇敌必像狮子从约旦河边的丛林上来，攻击坚固的居所。转眼之间，我要使以东人逃跑，离开这地。谁蒙拣选，我就派谁治理这地。谁能比我呢？谁能给我定规日期呢？有何牧人能在我面前站立得住呢？
49.en: “Behold, he will come up like a lion from the pride of the Jordan against the strong habitation; for I will suddenly make them run away from it, and whoever is chosen, I will appoint him over it. For who is like me? Who will appoint me a time? Who is the shepherd who will stand before me?”

49.zh: 你们要听耶和华攻击以东所说的谋略和他攻击提幔居民所定的旨意。仇敌定要将他们群众微弱的拉去，定要使他们的居所荒凉。
49.en: Therefore hear the counsel of the LORD, that he has taken against Edom, and his purposes that he has purposed against the inhabitants of Teman: Surely they will drag them away, the little ones of the flock. Surely he will make their habitation desolate over them.

49.zh: 因他们仆倒的声音，地就震动。人在红海那里必听见呼喊的声音。
49.en: The earth trembles at the noise of their fall; there is a cry, the noise which is heard in the Red Sea.

49.zh: 仇敌必如大鹰飞起，展开翅膀攻击波斯拉。到那日，以东的勇士心中疼痛如临产的妇人。」
49.en: Behold, he will come up and fly as the eagle, and spread out his wings against Bozrah. The heart of the mighty men of Edom at that day will be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.

49.zh: 论大马士革。 哈马和亚珥拔蒙羞， 因他们听见凶恶的信息就消化了。 海上有忧愁，不得平静。
49.en: Of Damascus: “Hamath and Arpad are confounded, for they have heard evil news. They have melted away. There is sorrow on the sea. It can’t be quiet.

49.zh: 大马士革发软，转身逃跑。 战兢将她捉住； 痛苦忧愁将她抓住， 如产难的妇人一样。
49.en: Damascus has grown feeble, she turns herself to flee, and trembling has seized her. Anguish and sorrows have taken hold of her, as of a woman in travail.

49.zh: 我所喜乐可称赞的城， 为何被撇弃了呢？
49.en: How is the city of praise not forsaken, the city of my joy?

49.zh: 她的少年人必仆倒在街上； 当那日，一切兵丁必默默无声。 这是万军之耶和华说的。
49.en: Therefore her young men will fall in her streets, and all the men of war will be brought to silence in that day,” says the LORD of Armies.

49.zh: 我必在大马士革城中使火着起， 烧灭便·哈达的宫殿。
49.en: “I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it will devour the palaces of Ben Hadad.”

49.zh: 论巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒所攻打的基达和夏琐的诸国。耶和华如此说： 迦勒底人哪，起来上基达去， 毁灭东方人。
49.en: Of Kedar, and of the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon struck, The LORD says: “Arise, go up to Kedar, and destroy the children of the east.

49.zh: 他们的帐棚和羊群都要夺去， 将幔子和一切器皿，并骆驼为自己掠去。 人向他们喊着说： 四围都有惊吓。
49.en: They will take their tents and their flocks. they will carry away for themselves their curtains, all their vessels, and their camels; and they will cry to them, ‘Terror on every side!’

49.zh: 耶和华说： 夏琐的居民哪，要逃奔远方， 住在深密处； 因为巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒设计谋害你们， 起意攻击你们。
49.en: Flee! Wander far off! Dwell in the depths, you inhabitants of Hazor,” says the LORD; “for Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has taken counsel against you, and has conceived a purpose against you.

49.zh: 耶和华说： 迦勒底人哪，起来！ 上安逸无虑的居民那里去； 他们是无门无闩、独自居住的。
49.en: Arise! Go up to a nation that is at ease, that dwells without care,” says the LORD; “that has neither gates nor bars, that dwells alone.

49.zh: 他们的骆驼必成为掠物； 他们众多的牲畜必成为掳物。 我必将剃周围[头发]的人分散四方， 使灾殃从四围临到他们。 这是耶和华说的。
49.en: Their camels will be a booty, and the multitude of their livestock a plunder. I will scatter to all winds those who have the corners of their beards cut off; and I will bring their calamity from every side of them,” says the LORD.

49.zh: 夏琐必成为野狗的住处， 永远凄凉； 必无人住在那里， 也无人在其中寄居。
49.en: Hazor will be a dwelling place of jackals, a desolation forever. No man will dwell there, neither will any son of man live therein.”

49.zh: 犹大王西底家登基的时候，耶和华论以拦的话临到先知耶利米说：
49.en: The LORD’s word that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning Elam, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, saying,

49.zh: 「万军之耶和华如此说：我必折断以拦人的弓，就是他们为首的权力。
49.en: “The LORD of Armies says: ‘Behold, I will break the bow of Elam, the chief of their might.

49.zh: 我要使四风从天的四方刮来，临到以拦人，将他们分散四方。这被赶散的人没有一国不到的。」
49.en: I will bring on Elam the four winds from the four quarters of the sky, and will scatter them toward all those winds. There will be no nation where the outcasts of Elam will not come.

49.zh: 耶和华说：「我必使以拦人在仇敌和寻索其命的人面前惊惶；我也必使灾祸，就是我的烈怒临到他们，又必使刀剑追杀他们，直到将他们灭尽。
49.en: I will cause Elam to be dismayed before their enemies, and before those who seek their life. I will bring evil on them, even my fierce anger,’ says the LORD; ‘and I will send the sword after them, until I have consumed them.

49.zh: 我要在以拦设立我的宝座，从那里除灭君王和首领。这是耶和华说的。
49.en: I will set my throne in Elam, and will destroy from there king and princes,’ says the LORD.

49.zh: 「到末后，我还要使被掳的以拦人归回。这是耶和华说的。」
49.en: ‘But it will happen in the latter days that I will reverse the captivity of Elam,’ says the LORD.”

50.zh: 耶和华借先知耶利米论巴比伦和迦勒底人之地所说的话。
50.en: The word that the LORD spoke concerning Babylon, concerning the land of the Chaldeans, by Jeremiah the prophet.

50.zh: 你们要在万国中传扬报告， 竖立大旗； 要报告，不可隐瞒，说： 巴比伦被攻取， 彼勒蒙羞， 米罗达惊惶。 巴比伦的神像都蒙羞； 她的偶像都惊惶。
50.en: “Declare among the nations and publish, and set up a standard; publish, and don’t conceal; say, ‘Babylon has been taken, Bel is disappointed, Merodach is dismayed! Her images are disappointed. Her idols are dismayed.’

50.zh: 「因有一国从北方上来攻击她，使她的地荒凉，无人居住，连人带牲畜都逃走了。」
50.en: For a nation comes up out of the north against her, which will make her land desolate, and no one will dwell in it. They have fled. They are gone, both man and animal.

50.zh: 耶和华说：「当那日子、那时候，以色列人要和犹大人同来，随走随哭，寻求耶和华—他们的　神。
50.en: “In those days, and in that time,” says the LORD, “the children of Israel will come, they and the children of Judah together; they will go on their way weeping, and will seek the LORD their God.

50.zh: 他们必访问锡安，又面向这里，[说]：『来吧，你们要与耶和华联合为永远不忘的约。』
50.en: They will inquire concerning Zion with their faces turned toward it, saying, ‘Come, and join yourselves to the LORD in an everlasting covenant that will not be forgotten.’

50.zh: 「我的百姓作了迷失的羊，牧人使他们走差路，使他们转到山上。他们从大山走到小山，竟忘了安歇之处。
50.en: My people have been lost sheep. Their shepherds have caused them to go astray. They have turned them away on the mountains. They have gone from mountain to hill. They have forgotten their resting place.

50.zh: 凡遇见他们的，就把他们吞灭。敌人说：『我们没有罪；因他们得罪那作公义居所的耶和华，就是他们列祖所仰望的耶和华。』
50.en: All who found them have devoured them. Their adversaries said, ‘We are not guilty, because they have sinned against the LORD, the habitation of righteousness, even the LORD, the hope of their fathers.’

50.zh: 「我[民哪]，你们要从巴比伦中逃走，从迦勒底人之地出去，要像羊群前面走的公山羊。
50.en: “Flee out of the middle of Babylon! Go out of the land of the Chaldeans, and be as the male goats before the flocks.

50.zh: 因我必激动联合的大国从北方上来攻击巴比伦，他们要摆阵攻击她；她必从那里被攻取。他们的箭好像善射之勇士的箭，一枝也不徒然返回。
50.en: For, behold, I will stir up and cause to come up against Babylon a company of great nations from the north country; and they will set themselves in array against her. She will be taken from there. Their arrows will be as of an expert mighty man. None of them will return in vain.

50.zh: 迦勒底必成为掠物；凡掳掠她的都必心满意足。这是耶和华说的。」
50.en: Chaldea will be a prey. All who prey on her will be satisfied,” says the LORD.

50.zh: 抢夺我产业的啊， 你们因欢喜快乐， 且像踹[谷]撒欢的母牛犊， 又像发嘶声的壮马。
50.en: “Because you are glad, because you rejoice, O you who plunder my heritage, because you are wanton as a heifer that treads out the grain, and neigh as strong horses,

50.zh: 你们的母巴比伦就极其抱愧， 生你们的必然蒙羞。 她要列在诸国之末， 成为旷野、旱地、沙漠。
50.en: your mother will be utterly disappointed. She who bore you will be confounded. Behold, she will be the least of the nations, a wilderness, a dry land, and a desert.

50.zh: 因耶和华的忿怒，必无人居住， 要全然荒凉。 凡经过巴比伦的要受惊骇， 又因她所遭的灾殃嗤笑。
50.en: Because of the LORD’s wrath she won’t be inhabited, but she will be wholly desolate. Everyone who goes by Babylon will be astonished, and hiss at all her plagues.

50.zh: 所有拉弓的，你们要在巴比伦的四围摆阵， 射箭攻击她。 不要爱惜箭枝， 因她得罪了耶和华。
50.en: Set yourselves in array against Babylon all around, all you who bend the bow; shoot at her. Spare no arrows, for she has sinned against the LORD.

50.zh: 你们要在她四围呐喊； 她已经投降。 外郭坍塌了， 城墙拆毁了， 因为这是耶和华报仇的事。 你们要向巴比伦报仇； 她怎样待人，也要怎样待她。
50.en: Shout against her all around. She has submitted herself. Her bulwarks have fallen. Her walls have been thrown down, for it is the vengeance of the LORD. Take vengeance on her. As she has done, do to her.

50.zh: 你们要将巴比伦撒种的 和收割时拿镰刀的都剪除了。 他们各人因怕欺压的刀剑， 必归回本族，逃到本土。
50.en: Cut off the sower from Babylon, and him who handles the sickle in the time of harvest. For fear of the oppressing sword, they will each return to their own people, and they will each flee to their own land.

50.zh: 「以色列是打散的羊，是被狮子赶出的。首先是亚述王将他吞灭，末后是巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒将他的骨头折断。」
50.en: “Israel is a hunted sheep. The lions have driven him away. First, the king of Assyria devoured him, and now at last Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has broken his bones.”

50.zh: 所以万军之耶和华—以色列的　神如此说：「我必罚巴比伦王和他的地，像我从前罚亚述王一样。
50.en: Therefore the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: “Behold, I will punish the king of Babylon and his land, as I have punished the king of Assyria.

50.zh: 我必再领以色列回他的草场，他必在迦密和巴珊吃草，又在以法莲山上和基列境内得以饱足。」
50.en: I will bring Israel again to his pasture, and he will feed on Carmel and Bashan. His soul will be satisfied on the hills of Ephraim and in Gilead.

50.zh: 耶和华说：「当那日子、那时候，虽寻以色列的罪孽，一无所有；虽寻犹大的罪恶，也无所见；因为我所留下的人，我必赦免。」
50.en: In those days, and in that time,” says the LORD, “the iniquity of Israel will be sought for, and there will be none, also the sins of Judah, and they won’t be found; for I will pardon them whom I leave as a remnant.

50.zh: 耶和华说：上去攻击米拉大翁之地， 又攻击比割的居民。 要追杀灭尽， 照我一切所吩咐你的去行。
50.en: “Go up against the land of Merathaim, even against it, and against the inhabitants of Pekod. Kill and utterly destroy after them,” says the LORD, “and do according to all that I have commanded you.

50.zh: 境内有打仗和大毁灭的响声。
50.en: A sound of battle is in the land, and of great destruction.

50.zh: 全地的大锤何竟砍断破坏？ 巴比伦在列国中何竟荒凉？
50.en: How the hammer of the whole earth is cut apart and broken! How Babylon has become a desolation among the nations!

50.zh: 巴比伦哪，我为你设下网罗， 你不知不觉被缠住。 你被寻着，也被捉住； 因为你与耶和华争竞。
50.en: I have laid a snare for you, and you are also taken, Babylon, and you weren’t aware. You are found, and also caught, because you have fought against the LORD.

50.zh: 耶和华已经开了武库， 拿出他恼恨的兵器； 因为主—万军之耶和华 在迦勒底人之地有[当做的事]。
50.en: The LORD has opened his armory, and has brought out the weapons of his indignation; for the Lord, GOD of Armies, has a work to do in the land of the Chaldeans.

50.zh: 你们要从极远的边界来攻击她， 开她的仓廪， 将她堆如高堆， 毁灭净尽，丝毫不留。
50.en: Come against her from the farthest border. Open her storehouses. Cast her up as heaps. Destroy her utterly. Let nothing of her be left.

50.zh: 要杀她的一切牛犊， 使他们下去遭遇杀戮。 他们有祸了， 因为追讨他们的日子已经来到。 （
50.en: Kill all her bulls. Let them go down to the slaughter. Woe to them! For their day has come, the time of their visitation.

50.zh: 有从巴比伦之地逃避出来的人，在锡安扬声报告耶和华—我们的　神报仇，就是为他的殿报仇。）
50.en: Listen to those who flee and escape out of the land of Babylon, to declare in Zion the vengeance of the LORD our God, the vengeance of his temple.

50.zh: 「招集一切弓箭手来攻击巴比伦。要在巴比伦四围安营，不要容一人逃脱，照着她所做的报应她；她怎样待人，也要怎样待她，因为她向耶和华—以色列的圣者发了狂傲。
50.en: “Call together the archers against Babylon, all those who bend the bow. Encamp against her all around. Let none of it escape. Pay her back according to her work. According to all that she has done, do to her; for she has been proud against the LORD, against the Holy One of Israel.

50.zh: 所以她的少年人必仆倒在街上。当那日，一切兵丁必默默无声。这是耶和华说的。」
50.en: Therefore her young men will fall in her streets. All her men of war will be brought to silence in that day,” says the LORD.

50.zh: 主—万军之耶和华说： 你这狂傲的啊，我与你反对， 因为我追讨你的日子已经来到。
50.en: “Behold, I am against you, you proud one,” says the Lord, GOD of Armies; “for your day has come, the time that I will visit you.

50.zh: 狂傲的必绊跌仆倒，无人扶起。 我也必使火在他的城邑中着起来， 将他四围所有的尽行烧灭。
50.en: The proud one will stumble and fall, and no one will raise him up. I will kindle a fire in his cities, and it will devour all who are around him.”

50.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说：「以色列人和犹大人一同受欺压；凡掳掠他们的都紧紧抓住他们，不肯释放。
50.en: The LORD of Armies says: “The children of Israel and the children of Judah are oppressed together. All who took them captive hold them fast. They refuse to let them go.

50.zh: 他们的救赎主大有能力，万军之耶和华是他的名。他必伸清他们的冤，好使全地得平安，并搅扰巴比伦的居民。」
50.en: Their Redeemer is strong. The LORD of Armies is his name. He will thoroughly plead their cause, that he may give rest to the earth, and disquiet the inhabitants of Babylon.

50.zh: 耶和华说：「 有刀剑临到迦勒底人和巴比伦的居民， 并她的首领与智慧人。
50.en: “A sword is on the Chaldeans,” says the LORD, “and on the inhabitants of Babylon, on her princes, and on her wise men.

50.zh: 有刀剑临到矜夸的人， 他们就成为愚昧； 有刀剑临到她的勇士， 他们就惊惶。
50.en: A sword is on the boasters, and they will become fools. A sword is on her mighty men, and they will be dismayed.

50.zh: 有刀剑临到她的马匹、车辆， 和其中杂族的人民； 他们必像妇女一样。 有刀剑临到她的宝物， 就被抢夺。
50.en: A sword is on their horses, on their chariots, and on all the mixed people who are in the middle of her; and they will become as women. A sword is on her treasures, and they will be robbed.

50.zh: 有干旱临到她的众水， 就必干涸； 因为这是有雕刻偶像之地， 人因偶像而颠狂。
50.en: A drought is on her waters, and they will be dried up; for it is a land of engraved images, and they are mad over idols.

50.zh: 所以旷野的走兽和豺狼必住在那里，鸵鸟也住在其中，永无人烟，世世代代无人居住。」
50.en: Therefore the wild animals of the desert with the wolves will dwell there. The ostriches will dwell therein. It will be inhabited no more forever, neither will it be lived in from generation to generation.

50.zh: 耶和华说：「必无人住在那里，也无人在其中寄居，要像我倾覆所多玛、蛾摩拉，和邻近的城邑一样。
50.en: As when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and its neighbor cities,” says the LORD, “so no man will dwell there, neither will any son of man live therein.

50.zh: 看哪，有一种民从北方而来， 并有一大国和许多君王被激动，从地极来到。
50.en: “Behold, a people comes from the north. A great nation and many kings will be stirred up from the uttermost parts of the earth.

50.zh: 他们拿弓和枪， 性情残忍，不施怜悯； 他们的声音像海浪匉訇。 巴比伦城啊， 他们骑马， 都摆队伍如上战场的人， 要攻击你。
50.en: They take up bow and spear. They are cruel, and have no mercy. Their voice roars like the sea. They ride on horses, everyone set in array, as a man to the battle, against you, daughter of Babylon.

50.zh: 巴比伦王听见他们的风声， 手就发软， 痛苦将他抓住， 疼痛仿佛产难的妇人。
50.en: The king of Babylon has heard the news of them, and his hands become feeble. Anguish has taken hold of him, pains as of a woman in labor.

50.zh: 「[仇敌]必像狮子从约旦河边的丛林上来，攻击坚固的居所。转眼之间，我要使他们逃跑，离开这地。谁蒙拣选，我就派谁治理这地。谁能比我呢？谁能给我定规日期呢？有何牧人能在我面前站立得住呢？
50.en: Behold, the enemy will come up like a lion from the thickets of the Jordan against the strong habitation; for I will suddenly make them run away from it. Whoever is chosen, I will appoint him over it, for who is like me? Who will appoint me a time? Who is the shepherd who can stand before me?”

50.zh: 你们要听耶和华攻击巴比伦所说的谋略和他攻击迦勒底人之地所定的旨意。仇敌定要将他们群众微弱的拉去，定要使他们的居所荒凉。
50.en: Therefore hear the counsel of the LORD that he has taken against Babylon; and his purposes that he has purposed against the land of the Chaldeans: Surely they will drag them away, even the little ones of the flock. Surely he will make their habitation desolate over them.

50.zh: 因巴比伦被取的声音，地就震动，人在列邦都听见呼喊的声音。」
50.en: The earth trembles at the noise of the taking of Babylon. The cry is heard among the nations.

51.zh: 耶和华如此说： 我必使毁灭的风刮起， 攻击巴比伦和住在立加米的人。
51.en: The LORD says: “Behold, I will raise up against Babylon, and against those who dwell in Lebkamai, a destroying wind.

51.zh: 我要打发外邦人来到巴比伦， 簸扬她，使她的地空虚。 在她遭祸的日子， 他们要周围攻击她。
51.en: I will send to Babylon strangers, who will winnow her. They will empty her land; for in the day of trouble they will be against her all around.

51.zh: 拉弓的，要向拉弓的和贯甲挺身的射箭。 不要怜惜她的少年人； 要灭尽她的全军。
51.en: Against him who bends, let the archer bend his bow, also against him who lifts himself up in his coat of mail. Don’t spare her young men! Utterly destroy all her army!

51.zh: 他们必在迦勒底人之地被杀仆倒， 在巴比伦的街上被刺透。
51.en: They will fall down slain in the land of the Chaldeans, and thrust through in her streets.

51.zh: 以色列和犹大虽然境内充满违背以色列圣者的罪， 却没有被他的　神—万军之耶和华丢弃。
51.en: For Israel is not forsaken, nor Judah, by his God, by the LORD of Armies; though their land is full of guilt against the Holy One of Israel.

51.zh: 你们要从巴比伦中逃奔， 各救自己的性命！ 不要陷在她的罪孽中一同灭亡； 因为这是耶和华报仇的时候， 他必向巴比伦施行报应。
51.en: “Flee out of the middle of Babylon! Everyone save his own life! Don’t be cut off in her iniquity, for it is the time of the LORD’s vengeance. He will give to her a recompense.

51.zh: 巴比伦素来是耶和华手中的金杯， 使天下沉醉； 万国喝了她的酒就颠狂了。
51.en: Babylon has been a golden cup in the LORD’s hand, who made all the earth drunk. The nations have drunk of her wine; therefore the nations have gone mad.

51.zh: 巴比伦忽然倾覆毁坏； 要为她哀号； 为止她的疼痛， 拿乳香或者可以治好。
51.en: Babylon has suddenly fallen and been destroyed! Wail for her! Take balm for her pain. Perhaps she may be healed.

51.zh: 我们想医治巴比伦， 她却没有治好。 离开她吧！我们各人归回本国； 因为她受的审判通于上天，达到穹苍。
51.en: “We would have healed Babylon, but she is not healed. Forsake her, and let’s each go into his own country; for her judgment reaches to heaven, and is lifted up even to the skies.

51.zh: 耶和华已经彰显我们的公义。 来吧！我们可以在锡安 报告耶和华—我们　神的作为。
51.en: ‘The LORD has produced our righteousness. Come, and let’s declare in Zion the work of the LORD our God.’

51.zh: 你们要磨尖了箭头， 抓住盾牌。 耶和华定意攻击巴比伦，将她毁灭，所以激动了米底亚君王的心；因这是耶和华报仇，就是为自己的殿报仇。
51.en: “Make the arrows sharp! Hold the shields firmly! The LORD has stirred up the spirit of the kings of the Medes, because his purpose is against Babylon, to destroy it; for it is the vengeance of the LORD, the vengeance of his temple.

51.zh: 你们要竖立大旗， 攻击巴比伦的城墙； 要坚固了望台， 派定守望的设下埋伏； 因为耶和华指着巴比伦居民所说的话、 所定的意，他已经作成。
51.en: Set up a standard against the walls of Babylon! Make the watch strong! Set the watchmen, and prepare the ambushes; for the LORD has both purposed and done that which he spoke concerning the inhabitants of Babylon.

51.zh: 住在众水之上多有财宝的啊， 你的结局到了！ 你贪婪之量满了！
51.en: You who dwell on many waters, abundant in treasures, your end has come, the measure of your covetousness.

51.zh: 万军之耶和华指着自己起誓[说]： 我必使[敌]人充满你，像蚂蚱一样； 他们必呐喊攻击你。
51.en: The LORD of Armies has sworn by himself, saying, ‘Surely I will fill you with men, as with locusts, and they will lift up a shout against you.’

51.zh: 耶和华用能力创造大地， 用智慧建立世界， 用聪明铺张穹苍。
51.en: “He has made the earth by his power. He has established the world by his wisdom. By his understanding he has stretched out the heavens.

51.zh: 他一发声，空中便有多水激动； 他使云雾从地极上腾。 他造电随雨而闪， 从他府库中带出风来。
51.en: When he utters his voice, there is a roar of waters in the heavens, and he causes the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth. He makes lightning for the rain, and brings the wind out of his treasuries.

51.zh: 各人都成了畜类，毫无知识。 各银匠都因他的偶像羞愧； 他所铸的偶像本是虚假的， 其中并无气息，
51.en: “Every man has become stupid and without knowledge. Every goldsmith is disappointed by his image, for his molten images are falsehood, and there is no breath in them.

51.zh: 都是虚无的，是迷惑人的工作， 到追讨的时候，必被除灭。
51.en: They are vanity, a work of delusion. In the time of their visitation, they will perish.

51.zh: 雅各的分不像这些， 因他是造作万有的[主]； 以色列也是他产业的支派。 万军之耶和华是他的名。
51.en: The portion of Jacob is not like these, for he formed all things, including the tribe of his inheritance. The LORD of Armies is his name.

51.zh: 你是我争战的斧子和打仗的兵器； 我要用你打碎列国， 用你毁灭列邦；
51.en: “You are my battle ax and weapons of war. With you I will break the nations into pieces. With you I will destroy kingdoms.

51.zh: 用你打碎马和骑马的； 用你打碎战车和坐在其上的；
51.en: With you I will break in pieces the horse and his rider.

51.zh: 用你打碎男人和女人； 用你打碎老年人和少年人； 用你打碎壮丁和处女；
51.en: With you I will break in pieces the chariot and him who rides therein. With you I will break in pieces man and woman. With you I will break in pieces the old man and the youth. With you I will break in pieces the young man and the virgin.

51.zh: 用你打碎牧人和他的群畜； 用你打碎农夫和他一对[牛]； 用你打碎省长和副省长。
51.en: With you I will break in pieces the shepherd and his flock. With you I will break in pieces the farmer and his yoke. With you I will break in pieces governors and deputies.

51.zh: 耶和华说：「我必在你们眼前报复巴比伦人和迦勒底居民在锡安所行的诸恶。」
51.en: “I will give to Babylon and to all the inhabitants of Chaldea all their evil that they have done in Zion in your sight,” says the LORD.

51.zh: 耶和华说： 你这行毁灭的山哪， 就是毁灭天下的山， 我与你反对。 我必向你伸手， 将你从山岩滚下去， 使你成为烧毁的山。
51.en: “Behold, I am against you, destroying mountain,” says the LORD, “which destroys all the earth. I will stretch out my hand on you, roll you down from the rocks, and will make you a burned mountain.

51.zh: 人必不从你那里取石头为房角石， 也不取石头为根基石； 你必永远荒凉。 这是耶和华说的。
51.en: They won’t take a cornerstone from you, nor a stone for foundations; but you will be desolate forever,” says the LORD.

51.zh: 要在境内竖立大旗， 在各国中吹角， 使列国预备攻击巴比伦， 将亚拉腊、米尼、亚实基拿各国招来攻击她； 又派军长来攻击她， 使马匹上来如蚂蚱，
51.en: “Set up a standard in the land! Blow the trumpet among the nations! Prepare the nations against her! Call together against her the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni, and Ashkenaz! Appoint a marshal against her! Cause the horses to come up as the swarming locusts!

51.zh: 使列国和米底亚君王，与省长和副省长， 并他们所管全地之人，都预备攻击她。
51.en: Prepare against her the nations, the kings of the Medes, its governors, and all its deputies, and all the land of their dominion!

51.zh: 地必震动而瘠苦； 因耶和华向巴比伦所定的旨意成立了， 使巴比伦之地荒凉，无人居住。
51.en: The land trembles and is in pain; for the purposes of the LORD against Babylon stand, to make the land of Babylon a desolation, without inhabitant.

51.zh: 巴比伦的勇士止息争战， 藏在坚垒之中。 他们的勇力衰尽，好像妇女一样。 巴比伦的住处有火着起， 门闩都折断了。
51.en: The mighty men of Babylon have stopped fighting, they remain in their strongholds. Their might has failed. They have become as women. Her dwelling places are set on fire. Her bars are broken.

51.zh: 跑报的要彼此相遇， 送信的要互相迎接， 报告巴比伦王说： 城的四方被攻取了，
51.en: One runner will run to meet another, and one messenger to meet another, to show the king of Babylon that his city is taken on every quarter.

51.zh: 渡口被占据了， 苇塘被火烧了， 兵丁也惊慌了。
51.en: So the passages are seized. They have burned the reeds with fire. The men of war are frightened.”

51.zh: 万军之耶和华—以色列的　神如此说： 巴比伦城好像踹谷的禾场； 再过片时，收割她的时候就到了。
51.en: For the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel says: “The daughter of Babylon is like a threshing floor at the time when it is trodden. Yet a little while, and the time of harvest comes for her.”

51.zh: 以色列人说： 巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒吞灭我，压碎我， 使我成为空虚的器皿。 他像大鱼将我吞下， 用我的美物充满他的肚腹， 又将我赶出去。
51.en: “Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon has devoured me. He has crushed me. He has made me an empty vessel. He has, like a monster, swallowed me up. He has filled his mouth with my delicacies. He has cast me out.

51.zh: 锡安的居民要说： 巴比伦以强暴待我， 损害我的身体， 愿这罪归给她。 耶路撒冷人要说： 愿流我们血的罪归到迦勒底的居民。
51.en: May the violence done to me and to my flesh be on Babylon!” the inhabitant of Zion will say; and, “May my blood be on the inhabitants of Chaldea!” will Jerusalem say.

51.zh: 所以，耶和华如此说： 我必为你伸冤，为你报仇； 我必使巴比伦的海枯竭，使她的泉源干涸。
51.en: Therefore the LORD says: “Behold, I will plead your cause, and take vengeance for you. I will dry up her sea, and make her fountain dry.

51.zh: 巴比伦必成为乱堆，为野狗的住处， 令人惊骇、嗤笑， 并且无人居住。
51.en: Babylon will become heaps, a dwelling place for jackals, an astonishment, and a hissing, without inhabitant.

51.zh: 他们要像少壮狮子咆哮， 像小狮子吼叫。
51.en: They will roar together like young lions. They will growl as lions’ cubs.

51.zh: 他们火热的时候， 我必为他们设摆酒席， 使他们沉醉，好叫他们快乐， 睡了长觉，永不醒起。 这是耶和华说的。
51.en: When they are inflamed, I will make their feast, and I will make them drunk, that they may rejoice, and sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake up,” says the LORD.

51.zh: 我必使他们像羊羔、 像公绵羊和公山羊下到宰杀之地。
51.en: “I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, like rams with male goats.

51.zh: 示沙克何竟被攻取？ 天下所称赞的何竟被占据？ 巴比伦在列国中何竟变为荒场？
51.en: “How Sheshach is taken! How the praise of the whole earth is seized! How Babylon has become a desolation among the nations!

51.zh: 海水涨起，漫过巴比伦； 她被许多海浪遮盖。
51.en: The sea has come up on Babylon. She is covered with the multitude of its waves.

51.zh: 她的城邑变为荒场、旱地、沙漠， 无人居住，无人经过之地。
51.en: Her cities have become a desolation, a dry land, and a desert, a land in which no man dwells. No son of man passes by it.

51.zh: 我必刑罚巴比伦的彼勒， 使他吐出所吞的。 万民必不再流归他那里； 巴比伦的城墙也必坍塌了。
51.en: I will execute judgment on Bel in Babylon, and I will bring out of his mouth that which he has swallowed up. The nations will not flow any more to him. Yes, the wall of Babylon will fall.

51.zh: 我的民哪，你们要从其中出去！ 各人拯救自己，躲避耶和华的烈怒。
51.en: “My people, go away from the middle of her, and each of you save yourselves from the LORD’s fierce anger.

51.zh: 你们不要心惊胆怯， 也不要因境内所听见的风声惧怕； 因为这年有风声传来； 那年也有风声[传来]， 境内有强暴的事， 官长攻击官长。
51.en: Don’t let your heart faint. Don’t fear for the news that will be heard in the land. For news will come one year, and after that in another year news will come, and violence in the land, ruler against ruler.

51.zh: 日子将到，我必刑罚巴比伦雕刻的偶像。 她全地必然抱愧； 她被杀的人必在其中仆倒。
51.en: Therefore behold, the days come that I will execute judgment on the engraved images of Babylon; and her whole land will be confounded. All her slain will fall in the middle of her.

51.zh: 那时，天地和其中所有的， 必因巴比伦欢呼， 因为行毁灭的要从北方来到她那里。 这是耶和华说的。
51.en: Then the heavens and the earth, and all that is therein, will sing for joy over Babylon; for the destroyers will come to her from the north,” says the LORD.

51.zh: 巴比伦怎样使以色列被杀的人仆倒， 照样她全地被杀的人也必在巴比伦仆倒。
51.en: “As Babylon has caused the slain of Israel to fall, so the slain of all the land will fall at Babylon.

51.zh: 你们躲避刀剑的要快走， 不要站住！ 要在远方记念耶和华， 心中追想耶路撒冷。
51.en: You who have escaped the sword, go! Don’t stand still! Remember the LORD from afar, and let Jerusalem come into your mind.”

51.zh: 我们听见辱骂就蒙羞，满面惭愧， 因为外邦人进入耶和华殿的圣所。
51.en: “We are confounded because we have heard reproach. Confusion has covered our faces, for strangers have come into the sanctuaries of the LORD’s house.”

51.zh: 耶和华说： 日子将到，我必刑罚巴比伦雕刻的偶像， 通国受伤的人必唉哼。
51.en: “Therefore behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that I will execute judgment on her engraved images; and through all her land the wounded will groan.

51.zh: 巴比伦虽升到天上， 虽使她坚固的高处更坚固， 还有行毁灭的从我这里到她那里。 这是耶和华说的。
51.en: Though Babylon should mount up to the sky, and though she should fortify the height of her strength, yet destroyers will come to her from me,” says the LORD.

51.zh: 有哀号的声音从巴比伦出来； 有大毁灭的响声从迦勒底人之地发出。
51.en: “The sound of a cry comes from Babylon, and of great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans!

51.zh: 因耶和华使巴比伦变为荒场， 使其中的大声灭绝。 仇敌仿佛众水， 波浪匉訇，响声已经发出。
51.en: For the LORD lays Babylon waste, and destroys out of her the great voice! Their waves roar like many waters. The noise of their voice is uttered.

51.zh: 这是行毁灭的临到巴比伦。 巴比伦的勇士被捉住， 他们的弓折断了； 因为耶和华是施行报应的　神， 必定施行报应。
51.en: For the destroyer has come on her, even on Babylon. Her mighty men are taken. Their bows are broken in pieces, for the LORD is a God of retribution. He will surely repay.

51.zh: 君王—名为万军之耶和华的说： 我必使巴比伦的首领、 智慧人、省长、副省长，和勇士都沉醉， 使他们睡了长觉，永不醒起。
51.en: I will make her princes, her wise men, her governors, her deputies, and her mighty men drunk. They will sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake up,” says the King, whose name is the LORD of Armies.

51.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说： 巴比伦宽阔的城墙必全然倾倒； 她高大的城门必被火焚烧。 众民所劳碌的必致虚空； 列国所劳碌的被火焚烧， 他们都必困乏。
51.en: The LORD of Armies says: “The wide walls of Babylon will be utterly overthrown. Her high gates will be burned with fire. The peoples will labor for vanity, and the nations for the fire; and they will be weary.”

51.zh: 犹大王西底家在位第四年，上巴比伦去的时候，玛西雅的孙子、尼利亚的儿子西莱雅与王同去（西莱雅是王宫的大臣），先知耶利米有话吩咐他。
51.en: The word which Jeremiah the prophet commanded Seraiah the son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, when he went with Zedekiah the king of Judah to Babylon in the fourth year of his reign. Now Seraiah was chief quartermaster.

51.zh: 耶利米将一切要临到巴比伦的灾祸，就是论到巴比伦的一切话，写在书上。
51.en: Jeremiah wrote in a book all the evil that should come on Babylon, even all these words that are written concerning Babylon.

51.zh: 耶利米对西莱雅说：「你到了巴比伦务要念这书上的话；
51.en: Jeremiah said to Seraiah, “When you come to Babylon, then see that you read all these words,

51.zh: 又说：『耶和华啊，你曾论到这地方说：要剪除，甚至连人带牲畜没有在这里居住的，必永远荒凉。』
51.en: and say, ‘LORD, you have spoken concerning this place, to cut it off, that no one will dwell in it, neither man nor animal, but that it will be desolate forever.’

51.zh: 你念完了这书，就把一块石头拴在书上，扔在幼发拉底河中，
51.en: It will be, when you have finished reading this book, that you shall bind a stone to it, and cast it into the middle of the Euphrates.

51.zh: 说：『巴比伦因耶和华所要降与她的灾祸，必如此沉下去，不再兴起，人民也必困乏。』」 耶利米的话到此为止。
51.en: Then you shall say, ‘Thus will Babylon sink, and will not rise again because of the evil that I will bring on her; and they will be weary.’” Thus far are the words of Jeremiah.

52.zh: 西底家登基的时候年二十一岁，在耶路撒冷作王十一年。他母亲名叫哈慕她，是立拿人耶利米的女儿。
52.en: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he began to reign. He reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

52.zh: 西底家行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，是照约雅敬一切所行的。
52.en: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.

52.zh: 因此耶和华的怒气在耶路撒冷和犹大发作，以致将人民从自己的面前赶出。
52.en: For through the LORD’s anger this happened in Jerusalem and Judah, until he had cast them out from his presence. Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

52.zh: 西底家背叛巴比伦王。他作王第九年十月初十日，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒率领全军来攻击耶路撒冷，对城安营，四围筑垒攻城。
52.en: In the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and encamped against it; and they built forts against it round about.

52.zh: 于是城被围困直到西底家王十一年。
52.en: So the city was besieged to the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.

52.zh: 四月初九日，城里有大饥荒，甚至百姓都没有粮食。
52.en: In the fourth month, in the ninth day of the month, the famine was severe in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.

52.zh: 城被攻破，一切兵丁就在夜间从靠近王园两城中间的门，出城逃跑；迦勒底人正在四围攻城。他们就往亚拉巴逃去。
52.en: Then a breach was made in the city, and all the men of war fled, and went out of the city by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which was by the king’s garden. Now the Chaldeans were against the city all around. The men of war went toward the Arabah,

52.zh: 迦勒底的军队追赶西底家王，在耶利哥的平原追上他。他的全军都离开他四散了。
52.en: but the army of the Chaldeans pursued the king, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.

52.zh: 迦勒底人就拿住王，带他到在哈马地利比拉的巴比伦王那里；巴比伦王便审判他。
52.en: Then they took the king, and carried him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath; and he pronounced judgment on him.

52.zh: 巴比伦王在西底家眼前杀了他的众子，又在利比拉杀了犹大的一切首领，
52.en: The king of Babylon killed the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes. He also killed all the princes of Judah in Riblah.

52.zh: 并且剜了西底家的眼睛，用铜链锁着他，带到巴比伦去，将他囚在监里，直到他死的日子。
52.en: He put out the eyes of Zedekiah; and the king of Babylon bound him in fetters, and carried him to Babylon, and put him in prison until the day of his death.

52.zh: 巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒十九年五月初十日，在巴比伦王面前侍立的护卫长尼布撒拉旦进入耶路撒冷，
52.en: Now in the fifth month, in the tenth day of the month, which was the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard, who stood before the king of Babylon, came into Jerusalem.

52.zh: 用火焚烧耶和华的殿和王宫，又焚烧耶路撒冷的房屋，就是各大户家的房屋。
52.en: He burned the LORD’s house, and the king’s house; and all the houses of Jerusalem, even every great house, he burned with fire.

52.zh: 跟从护卫长迦勒底的全军就拆毁耶路撒冷四围的城墙。
52.en: All the army of the Chaldeans, who were with the captain of the guard, broke down all the walls of Jerusalem all around.

52.zh: 那时护卫长尼布撒拉旦将民中最穷的和城里所剩下的百姓，并已经投降巴比伦王的人，以及大众所剩下的人，都掳去了。
52.en: Then Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive of the poorest of the people, and the rest of the people who were left in the city, and those who fell away, who defected to the king of Babylon, and the rest of the multitude.

52.zh: 但护卫长尼布撒拉旦留下些民中最穷的，使他们修理葡萄园，耕种田地。
52.en: But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left of the poorest of the land to be vineyard keepers and farmers.

52.zh: 耶和华殿的铜柱并殿内的[盆]座和铜海，迦勒底人都打碎了，将那铜运到巴比伦去了，
52.en: The Chaldeans broke the pillars of bronze that were in the LORD’s house and the bases and the bronze sea that were in the LORD’s house in pieces, and carried all of their bronze to Babylon.

52.zh: 又带去锅、铲子、蜡剪、盘子、调羹，并所用的一切铜器、
52.en: They also took away the pots, the shovels, the snuffers, the basins, the spoons, and all the vessels of bronze with which they ministered.

52.zh: 杯、火鼎、碗、盆、灯台、调羹、爵，无论金的银的，护卫长也都带去了。
52.en: The captain of the guard took away the cups, the fire pans, the basins, the pots, the lamp stands, the spoons, and the bowls; that which was of gold, as gold, and that which was of silver, as silver.

52.zh: 所罗门为耶和华殿所造的两根[铜]柱、一个[铜]海，并座下的十二只铜牛，这一切的铜多得无法可称。
52.en: They took the two pillars, the one sea, and the twelve bronze bulls that were under the bases, which King Solomon had made for the LORD’s house. The bronze of all these vessels was without weight.

52.zh: 这一根柱子高十八肘，厚四指，是空的，围十二肘。
52.en: As for the pillars, the height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits; and a line of twelve cubits encircled it; and its thickness was four fingers. It was hollow.

52.zh: 柱上有铜顶，高五肘；铜顶的周围有网子和石榴，都是铜的。那一根柱子照此一样，也有石榴。
52.en: A capital of bronze was on it; and the height of the one capital was five cubits, with network and pomegranates on the capital all around, all of bronze. The second pillar also had the same, with pomegranates.

52.zh: 柱子四面有九十六个石榴，在网子周围，共有一百石榴。
52.en: There were ninety-six pomegranates on the sides; all the pomegranates were one hundred on the network all around.

52.zh: 护卫长拿住大祭司西莱雅、副祭司西番亚，和三个把门的，
52.en: The captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the threshold,

52.zh: 又从城中拿住一个管理兵丁的官，并在城里所遇常见王面的七个人和检点国民军长的书记，以及城里所遇见的国民六十个人。
52.en: and out of the city he took an officer who was set over the men of war; and seven men of those who saw the king’s face, who were found in the city; and the scribe of the captain of the army, who mustered the people of the land; and sixty men of the people of the land, who were found in the middle of the city.

52.zh: 护卫长尼布撒拉旦将这些人带到利比拉的巴比伦王那里。
52.en: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah.

52.zh: 巴比伦王就把他们击杀在哈马地的利比拉。这样，犹大人被掳去离开本地。
52.en: The king of Babylon struck them, and put them to death at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was carried away captive out of his land.

52.zh: 尼布甲尼撒所掳的民数记在下面：在他第七年掳去犹大人三千零二十三名；
52.en: This is the number of the people whom Nebuchadnezzar carried away captive: in the seventh year, three thousand twenty-three Jews;

52.zh: 尼布甲尼撒十八年从耶路撒冷掳去八百三十二人；
52.en: in the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar, he carried away captive from Jerusalem eight hundred thirty-two persons;

52.zh: 尼布甲尼撒二十三年，护卫长尼布撒拉旦掳去犹大人七百四十五名；共有四千六百人。
52.en: in the twenty-third year of Nebuchadnezzar, Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive of the Jews seven hundred forty-five people. All the people numbered four thousand six hundred.

52.zh: 犹大王约雅斤被掳后三十七年，巴比伦王以未·米罗达[元]年十二月二十五日，使犹大王约雅斤抬头，提他出监，
52.en: In the thirty-seventh year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, in the twenty-fifth day of the month, Evilmerodach king of Babylon, in the first year of his reign, lifted up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah, and released him from prison.

52.zh: 又对他说恩言，使他的位高过与他一同在巴比伦众王的位，
52.en: He spoke kindly to him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings who were with him in Babylon,

52.zh: 给他脱了囚服。他终身在巴比伦王面前吃饭。
52.en: and changed his prison garments. Jehoiachin ate bread before him continually all the days of his life.

52.zh: 巴比伦王赐他所需用的食物，日日赐他一分，终身是这样，直到他死的日子。
52.en: For his allowance, there was a continual allowance given him by the king of Babylon, every day a portion until the day of his death, all the days of his life.
